MessyMem: Learning-from-Doing Memory for Mobile Manipulation Manipulation

persistent memory scene graph mobile manipulation interaction learning experience reuse

简要说明：MessyMem 提出了一种针对移动操作机器人的持久空间记忆系统，通过存储交互知识和视觉关键帧，使机器人在长期任务中能够积累经验并提升性能。

TLDR: MessyMem introduces a persistent, spatially grounded memory system for mobile manipulators that stores interaction-derived knowledge and visual keyframes, enabling robots to improve task performance over time in both simulation and real-world settings.

Abstract: Mobile manipulators deployed across many rooms and visits should improve with experience: after discovering that a cabinet is locked or finding an object in a drawer, the robot should reuse that knowledge rather than start each task from scratch. Yet today's robots often treat each task as new: compact scene representations omit interaction-derived knowledge, raw video histories are difficult to query, and VLM planners reason at inference time without persistently updating what the robot knows. We present MessyMem, a persistent memory system that enables mobile manipulators to learn from experience and reuse that knowledge across future tasks. It maintains a spatially grounded 3D scene graph of objects and locations, augments it with properties and outcomes learned through interaction, and links visual observations for fine-grained recall. We evaluate MessyMem in simulation and on a real mobile manipulator. In a continuous 25-task simulation spanning over 3 hours, MessyMem achieves 80.0% task progress, outperforming the strongest ablation by 14.8 percentage points and the strongest external baseline by 28.9 points, while retrieving task-relevant evidence from thousands of stored keyframes and over an hour into the past.

摘要（中文）：移动操作机器人在多房间、多场景部署中应能随经验而改进：在发现柜子被锁或从抽屉中取到物品后，机器人应复用这些知识，而不是每次任务都从零开始。然而，如今的机器人往往将每项任务视为全新任务：紧凑的场景表示舍弃了交互获得的知识，原始视频历史难以查询，而VLM规划器仅在推理时推理，未能持续更新机器人所掌握的信息。我们提出MessyMem，一种持久记忆系统，使移动操作机器人能够从经验中学习并在未来任务中复用这些知识。它维护一个基于空间的三维场景图，记录物体和位置，并通过交互习得的属性与结果对场景图进行扩充，同时关联视觉观察以实现细粒度回忆。我们在仿真环境和真实移动操作机器人上对MessyMem进行了评估。在一项跨越3个多小时、包含25个连续任务的仿真中，MessyMem实现了80.0%的任务进展，比最强消融模型高出14.8个百分点，比最强外部基线高出28.9个百分点，同时能从数千个存储关键帧中检索到任务相关证据，时间跨度超过一小时。

Authors: Anuva Banwasi, William Muckelroy, Priya Sundaresan, Linfeng Zhao, Jeannette Bohg, Cherie Ho

Beyond Single-Axis Testing: Paired Evaluation of Compound Robustness in Vision-Language-Action Policies VLA

compound robustness vision-language-action policies multi-axis perturbation benchmark success rate

简要说明：本文提出了LIBERO-CTRL，一个用于评估视觉-语言-动作策略复合鲁棒性的六轴基准，通过配对单轴与同时扰动，揭示了聚合单轴成功率无法预测复合性能，原因在于涌现性失败和补偿性成功。

TLDR: This paper introduces LIBERO-CTRL, a six-axis benchmark for evaluating compound robustness in vision-language-action policies by pairing single-axis and simultaneous perturbations, revealing that aggregate single-axis success rates cannot predict compound performance due to emergent failures and compensated successes.

Abstract: Vision-language-action policies are typically evaluated one perturbation at a time, providing a useful diagnosis of their sensitivity to individual distribution shifts. Real-world deployment, however, may involve several shifts simultaneously, and it remains unclear how these individual robustness measurements compose. We ask whether compound robustness can be inferred from single-axis evaluations. We introduce LIBERO-CTRL, a six-axis benchmark that pairs each initial state across single-axis conditions and a matched simultaneous condition. This design reveals two opposing outcome changes that aggregate success rates cannot distinguish: emergent failures, where all single-axis rollouts succeed but the simultaneous rollout fails, and compensated successes, where at least one single-axis rollout fails but the simultaneous rollout succeeds. Because one transition decreases compound success while the other increases it, they can cancel, making aggregate compound performance appear consistent with single-axis measurements even when individual outcomes differ substantially. These opposing transitions can largely cancel in aggregate: even when the difference between the two transition rates is not statistically distinguishable from zero, as many as 29.0% of matched initial states still change outcome. Across six policies and three severity levels, such outcome changes reach 34.5% in the most affected condition. The relative prevalence of the two transitions varies across policies and severities, while the transition rates remain similar under independent re-evaluation of stochastic policies. Compound robustness therefore cannot be characterized from aggregate single-axis success rates alone; matched per-instance evaluation is needed to reveal how joint perturbations alter behavior.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作策略通常一次只针对一种扰动进行评估，从而对它们各自对单一分布偏移的敏感性提供有用的诊断。然而，现实世界的部署可能同时涉及多种偏移，而这些单一鲁棒性度量如何组合仍不清楚。我们研究是否可以从单轴评估中推断出复合鲁棒性。我们引入了LIBERO-CTRL，一个六轴基准，将单轴条件下的每个初始状态与匹配的同步条件配对。这一设计揭示了两种对立的结局变化，而聚合成功率无法区分它们：涌现失败，即所有单轴轨迹均成功但同步轨迹失败；以及补偿成功，即至少一个单轴轨迹失败但同步轨迹成功。由于一种转变降低了复合成功率，而另一种提高了它，它们可能相互抵消，使得聚合复合性能看起来与单轴测量一致，即使各个结局差异显著。这些对立的转变在聚合中可能在很大程度上相互抵消：即使两种转变率之间的差异在统计上与零无法区分，仍有高达29.0%的匹配初始状态发生变化。在六种策略和三种严重程度下，这种结局变化在最受影响的条件中达到34.5%。两种转变的相对普遍性因策略和严重程度而异，而在随机策略的独立重评估下，转变率保持相似。因此，复合鲁棒性无法仅从聚合的单轴成功率中推断出来；需要匹配的逐实例评估来揭示联合扰动如何改变行为。

Authors: Hiroki Sawada, Shunichi Kasahara

WLA$^3$: World Latent Action Modeling for Semantics, Dynamics, and Kinematics VLA

World Latent Action Model generalist policy model human-to-robot transfer latent actions VLM supervision

简要说明：本文提出 WLA^3，一种通过世界潜在动作模型从多模态世界状态和人类视频中学习统一动作监督，用于语义、动力学和运动学的通用策略模型，在真实机器人操作任务上取得了优异成绩。

TLDR: This paper introduces WLA^3, a generalist policy model that learns a World Latent Action Model from multimodal world states and human videos to provide unified action supervision for semantics, dynamics, and kinematics, achieving strong real-robot manipulation results.

Abstract: Scaling generalist policy models with heterogeneous data is limited by the lack of unified, low-noise action supervision. Human egocentric videos are abundant, but only a small fraction comes with high-quality hand-action labels. Observed world transitions offer a common source of action-related supervision across data sources. We introduce WLA$^3$ (World Latent Action Modeling for Semantics, Dynamics, and Kinematics), a unified generalist policy model framework built around representations learned by a World Latent Action Model (WLAM). WLAM first learns how multimodal world states change over a local interval, encoding synchronized camera views and available embodiment-state changes into a compact local latent action and a richer transition feature. Reconstruction from partial modalities and consistency across overlapping windows encourage robust transition representations. WLA$^3$ reuses them across semantics, dynamics, and kinematics: local latent actions support action-sensitive physical-dynamics modeling, segment-level features directly supervise the VLM through a Semantic Latent Aggregate (SLA), and an action expert jointly predicts latent actions together with embodiment-specific robot controls. Human videos provide scalable transition supervision, while robot trajectories ground the shared representation in executable native controls. On LARYBench, the final 32D latent action reaches 67.89\% average classification accuracy. WLA$^3$ achieves 81.9% average success across six real-robot tasks versus 66.2% for $π_{0.5}$. Performance improves as generalist policy model mid-training data scales, and human videos support human-to-robot transfer. Project page can be found at https://wla-3.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：扩展基于异构数据的通用策略模型受限于缺乏统一、低噪声的动作监督。人类自我中心视频数量丰富，但其中只有一小部分带有高质量的手部动作标注。跨数据源的观测世界转移提供了一种通用的与动作相关的监督来源。我们提出了WLA$^3$（用于语义、动力学与运动学的世界潜在动作建模），这是一个统一的通用策略模型框架，其核心是基于世界潜在动作模型（WLAM）学习得到的表示。WLAM首先学习多模态世界状态在局部时间区间内如何演化，将同步的相机视角与可用的具身状态变化编码为一个紧凑的局部潜在动作以及一个更丰富的转移特征。通过部分模态的重建以及跨重叠窗口的一致性约束，促使模型学习到稳健的转移表示。WLA$^3$在语义、动力学和运动学三个层面复用这些表示：局部潜在动作支持对动作敏感的物理动力学建模；片段级特征通过语义潜在聚合（SLA）直接监督视觉语言模型（VLM）；动作专家则联合预测潜在动作以及具身特定机器人控制指令。人类视频提供了可扩展的转移监督，而机器人轨迹则将共享表示锚定到可执行的原生控制命令上。在LARYBench基准上，最终的32维潜在动作达到了67.89%的平均分类准确率。在六个真实机器人任务中，WLA$^3$实现了81.9%的平均成功率，而$π_{0.5}$仅为66.2%。随着通用策略模型中期训练数据规模的扩大，性能持续提升，且人类视频支持人机迁移。项目页面可见于 https://wla-3.github.io/。

Authors: Peidong Liu, Zhiyuan Xiang, Mingyang Li, Wenhao Li, Jiale Zhang, Jiahao Sun, Jiawei Li

DIDO: Distilling Interaction-Centric Dynamics into One-Step Denoising for World Action Models WorldModel

World Action Model distribution matching distillation interaction-centric representation guidance video generation robotic manipulation

简要说明：DIDO 将多步视频世界动作模型蒸馏为单步去噪模型，通过交互中心表示引导保留夹爪与物体的交互动态，大幅降低推理延迟，在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 及真实世界任务中取得了高成功率。

TLDR: DIDO distills a multi-step video-based World Action Model into a single-step denoiser for robotic manipulation, using interaction-centric representation guidance to preserve gripper-object dynamics while drastically reducing inference latency, achieving high success rates on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin, and real-world tasks.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) use video generation models to predict future visual dynamics for robotic manipulation, but iterative denoising introduces additional latency for closed-loop control. We empirically find that visual content converges at different rates during denoising. Static background structure forms early, whereas the gripper and manipulated object remain blurry after the first step, with their interaction dynamics emerging only through subsequent denoising. Consequently, naively truncating a multi-step video model to one step preserves scene structure but loses the interaction-centric dynamics most critical for manipulation. To address this issue, we propose DIDO, which distills the converged dynamics of a multi-step video model into a single denoising step. DIDO combines distribution matching distillation with interaction-centric representation guidance. Beyond compressing multi-step generation into one forward pass, DIDO explicitly models the gripper, manipulated object, and their interaction using supervised bounding-box visual reasoning tokens. Additionally, DIDO aligns the target object's representations across multiple model layers with features from a pretrained DINOv3 encoder. This interaction-centric guidance helps the distilled model preserve both the relevant entities and their future dynamics in a single step, while substantially reducing inference latency. DIDO achieves an average success rate of 99.0\% on LIBERO, 76.6\% on LIBERO-Plus, and 92.0\% on RoboTwin, while also demonstrating effective transfer to long-horizon and generalization tasks in real-world robotic manipulation.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）利用视频生成模型预测机器人操作中的未来视觉动态，但迭代去噪过程为闭环控制引入了额外延迟。我们通过实验发现，视觉内容在去噪过程中以不同速率收敛：静态背景结构较早形成，而夹爪和被操作物体在第一步之后仍保持模糊，其交互动态仅通过后续去噪才逐渐显现。因此，简单地将多步视频模型截断为单步，虽然保留了场景结构，却丢失了对操作最为关键的以交互为中心的动态信息。为解决这一问题，我们提出DIDO，将多步视频模型的收敛动态蒸馏到单步去噪中。DIDO结合了分布匹配蒸馏与以交互为中心的表征引导。除了将多步生成压缩为单次前向传播外，DIDO还利用监督边界框视觉推理标记显式建模夹爪、被操作物体及其交互。此外，DIDO将目标物体在多个模型层中的表征与预训练DINOv3编码器的特征进行对齐。这种以交互为中心的引导帮助蒸馏模型在单步中同时保留相关实体及其未来动态，同时显著降低推理延迟。DIDO在LIBERO上达到99.0\%的平均成功率，在LIBERO-Plus上达到76.6\%，在RoboTwin上达到92.0\%，并在真实机器人操作中展示了向长时程和泛化任务的有效迁移能力。

Authors: Jing Lyu, Shuanghao Bai, Runze Xiao, Zhenyu Liao, Wenxing Tan, Zihan Tang, Ruochuan Shi, Cheng Peng, Yuheng Ji, Yihao Wang, Badong Chen, Pengwei Wang, Zhongyuan Wang, Xiaoguang Zhao

X-WBC: A Cross-Embodiment Foundation Model for Humanoid Whole-Body Control HumanoidEmbodied

cross-embodiment whole-body control humanoid foundation model joint training

简要说明：X-WBC 提出了一个人形全身控制的跨本体基础模型，通过以人为中心的命令标记和机器人特定模块分离共享运动语义与特定本体的物理执行，在仿真和真实机器人上展示了改进的跟踪效果。

TLDR: X-WBC introduces a cross-embodiment foundation model for humanoid whole-body control, separating shared motion semantics from embodiment-specific execution via human-centered command tokens and robot-specific modules, demonstrating improved tracking across simulations and real robots.

Abstract: Scaling humanoid whole-body control toward general-purpose deployment requires large human motion corpora and training experience shared across robot bodies. Existing methods usually train one policy per robot, leaving motion experience isolated across embodiments. We introduce X-WBC, a cross-embodiment foundation framework that separates relatively shared human motion semantics from embodiment-specific physical execution. Human-centered command tokens align full human motion, robot reference motion, and sparse VR observations. A causal Transformer learns reusable temporal structure from mixed multi-robot rollouts, while lightweight robot-specific modules map the shared representation to each robot's proprioception and action space. Across nine simulated embodiments, external motions, and four real robots, experiments show that joint training improves tracking, the aligned representation supports consistent control across command sources, and the learned policy remains competitive beyond the training corpus. These results support heterogeneous humanoids as joint data sources and establish cross-embodiment joint training as a practical route toward whole-body control foundation models.

摘要（中文）：将类人全身控制扩展到通用部署，需要大规模人类运动语料库以及跨机器人本体共享的训练经验。现有方法通常为每台机器人单独训练一个策略，导致运动经验在不同本体之间相互隔离。我们提出了X-WBC，一个跨本体的基础框架，将相对共享的人类运动语义与特定本体的物理执行分离。以人为中心的命令标记对齐完整的人类运动、机器人参考运动以及稀疏的VR观测。一个因果Transformer从混合的多机器人轨迹中学习可复用的时间结构，而轻量级的机器人特定模块将共享表征映射到各机器人的本体感知和动作空间。在九个模拟本体、外部运动以及四台真实机器人上的实验表明，联合训练提升了跟踪性能，对齐的表征支持跨命令来源的一致控制，且学习到的策略在训练语料之外仍保持竞争力。这些结果支持将异质类人机器人作为联合数据源，并确立了跨本体联合训练作为实现全身控制基础模型的实用路径。

Authors: Juntong Zhang, Chun Gu, Li Zhang

GRAVA: Grounded Reasoning-to-Action Representation and Learning for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

Vision-Language-Action Grounded Reasoning Autonomous Driving Autoregressive Policy Benchmark

简要说明：GRAVA提出了一个用于自动驾驶的接地推理到动作（GRA）框架，在单一VLM流中统一了接地、推理和动作生成，并在NAVSIM基准上实现了最先进的性能，改善了长尾合规性和闭环评分。

TLDR: GRAVA introduces a Grounded Reasoning-to-Action (GRA) framework for autonomous driving, unifying grounding, reasoning, and action generation in a single VLM stream, and demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on the NAVSIM benchmark with improved long-tail compliance and closed-loop scores.

Abstract: Driving vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly reason before acting, but their intermediate reasoning is often weakly grounded in physical scene evidence and loosely connected to executable behavior. We present GRAVA, a framework built around Grounded Reasoning-to-Action (GRA), which unifies grounding, reasoning, and action generation in a single autoregressive stream. GRA links action-relevant language references to 2D visual regions and ego-centric physical states, organizes object interactions and decisions in a trajectory-anchored typed graph, and serializes this structure into grounded reasoning. A single VLM generates this reasoning followed by a compact Executable Planner action that is deterministically decoded into a continuous trajectory. We further introduce an agentic GRA data construction pipeline that combines forward scene grounding with backward trajectory anchoring, and use it to build GR-NavSim with 2.2M grounded question-answer pairs and 70K GRA reasoning traces. A progressive training strategy develops grounded cognition through pre-training, establishes the reasoning-to-action interface through imitation, and improves driving behavior through reinforcement learning and exploration. Using about 60% of the available human driving demonstrations for action supervision, GRAVA-8B achieves state-of-the-art performance among purely autoregressive driving models on the full NAVSIM benchmark. On an internal long-tail benchmark, full GRA improves key-object compliance and Closed-loop Driving Score by 19.3% and 20.5% over action-only prediction, respectively. These results show the benefit of preserving action-relevant physical evidence from grounded reasoning through executable action generation.

摘要（中文）：驾驶视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在行动前越来越多地进行推理，但其中间推理往往缺乏对物理场景证据的充分锚定，且与可执行行为之间的关联较为松散。我们提出GRAVA，一个围绕“接地推理到动作”（Grounded Reasoning-to-Action, GRA）构建的框架，将接地、推理与动作生成统一在单一的自回归流中。GRA将动作相关的语言指涉关联到二维视觉区域及以自我为中心的物理状态，在轨迹锚定的类型化图中组织对象交互与决策，并将该结构序列化为接地推理。单个视觉语言模型（VLM）生成该推理，随后生成紧凑的“可执行规划器”动作，该动作被确定性解码为连续轨迹。我们进一步引入一种智能体式GRA数据构建流程，将前向场景接地与后向轨迹锚定相结合，并据此构建包含220万条接地问答对和7万条GRA推理轨迹的GR-NavSim数据集。一种渐进式训练策略通过预训练发展接地认知，通过模仿建立推理到动作的接口，并通过强化学习与探索改善驾驶行为。在仅使用可用人类驾驶演示中约60%的数据进行动作监督的情况下，GRAVA-8B在完整NAVSIM基准上达到纯自回归驾驶模型中的最优性能。在一个内部长尾基准上，完整的GRA相比仅动作预测，在关键对象符合率和闭环驾驶得分上分别提升了19.3%和20.5%。这些结果证明了在可执行动作生成过程中保留接地推理中动作相关物理证据的益处。

Authors: Xiao Liu, Haoyu Li, Jianghao Leng, Lin Wang, Chao Sun

IMPACT-VLA: Interaction-aware Multimodal Propagation Attribution via Counterfactual Trajectories for Vision-Language-Action Policies VLA

Vision-Language-Action Counterfactual Attribution Closed-loop Re-execution Behavioral Phases LIBERO

简要说明：本文提出IMPACT-VLA，一种基于闭环反事实轨迹的归因方法，用于分析VLA机器人策略中阶段-模态贡献及跨阶段交互，并在30个LIBERO操作任务上验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces IMPACT-VLA, a closed-loop counterfactual attribution method that identifies phase-modality contributions and cross-phase interactions in VLA robot policies, validated on 30 LIBERO manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies perform robot manipulation tasks using multimodal inputs such as visual observations, proprioceptive states, and language instructions. However, it remains unclear at which execution stages each modality contributes to final task success and how input interventions propagate through subsequent states, observations, and actions. Existing attribution approaches primarily measure local sensitivity or temporally aggregated importance, limiting their ability to capture phase-dependent contributions and cross-phase dependencies. We propose Interaction-aware Multimodal Propagation Attribution via Counterfactual Trajectories for Vision-Language-Action Policies (IMPACT-VLA). IMPACT-VLA constructs behavioral phases from action transitions in a successful reference rollout, aligns them with policy query boundaries, and defines phase-modality blocks as attribution units. It then performs closed-loop counterfactual re-execution to quantify each block's contribution to final task success. We further analyze cross-phase non-additive interactions and trajectory propagation while distinguishing behavioral from functional recovery. Across 30 LIBERO robot manipulation tasks using OpenVLA-OFT, dominant-modality transitions occurred in 25 tasks (83.3%), and closed-loop attribution identified task-critical information more faithfully than Static Action Perturbation. Later-block marginal gains for negatively interacting pairs increased by approximately 3.3x under early-phase input replacement, while functional recovery could occur without behavioral recovery. These results reveal when multimodal inputs support task success and how their contributions become conditionally coupled during closed-loop execution.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作策略利用多模态输入（如视觉观测、本体感觉状态和语言指令）执行机器人操作任务。然而，各模态在执行的哪些阶段对最终任务成功做出贡献，以及输入干预如何通过后续状态、观测和动作传播，目前仍不明确。现有归因方法主要衡量局部敏感性或时间聚合重要性，难以捕捉阶段依赖贡献和跨阶段依赖关系。我们提出基于反事实轨迹的视觉-语言-动作策略交互感知多模态传播归因方法。该方法从成功参考轨迹中的动作转换构建行为阶段，将其与策略查询边界对齐，并定义阶段-模态块作为归因单元；随后执行闭环反事实重执行以量化每个块对最终任务成功的贡献。我们进一步分析跨阶段非加性交互和轨迹传播，同时区分行为恢复与功能恢复。在30个使用OpenVLA-OFT的LIBERO机器人操作任务中，主导模态转换出现在25个任务中，闭环归因相比静态动作扰动更忠实地识别了任务关键信息。在早期阶段输入替换下，负交互对的后期块边际增益增加约3.3倍，而功能恢复可能在无行为恢复的情况下发生。这些结果揭示了多模态输入在何时支持任务成功，以及其贡献在闭环执行过程中如何条件性耦合。

Authors: Jinwoong Kim, Sangjin Park

Real-World Reinforcement Learning with MPC Scaffolding for Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

real-world RL model predictive control dexterous manipulation soft actor-critic in-hand manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种以MPC为脚手架的实时RL框架，利用少量MPC轨迹进行预训练和在线间歇指导，在16自由度Allegro手上实现了快速、低干预的灵巧操作策略学习。

TLDR: This paper introduces an MPC-scaffolded real-world RL framework that uses a small set of MPC trajectories for pretraining and intermittent online guidance, enabling fast, low-intervention learning of dexterous manipulation policies (e.g., in-hand rotation) on a 16-DoF Allegro hand.

Abstract: Real-world reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising route to dexterous manipulation policies that can adapt directly from physical interaction, but learning is hindered by inefficient early exploration and costly failures. We propose a framework that uses sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) as scaffolding for real-world dexterous RL, providing structured prior experience and task-directed guidance during learning without human demonstrations or corrective actions. A small set of MPC trajectories is first used to populate an offline replay buffer and to pretrain the actor and critic. During online learning, MPC intermittently guides data collection while an off-policy Soft Actor-Critic learner trains from both prior MPC experience and newly collected physical interaction, with control gradually transitioning to the learned policy. On continuous in-hand rotation with a 16-DoF Allegro hand, the method reaches 100\% success in policy-only evaluation (5/5 trials) after 7 minutes of online RL, following initialization with 20 MPC trajectories collected on hardware in 12 minutes. Online training incurs about three object drops on average. After 20 minutes of online learning, the policy achieves more than five times the rotation speed of the MPC controller. It completes 1000 consecutive rotations over more than 110 minutes without a drop. Ablations show complementary benefits from MPC-based pretraining, retained MPC experience, and online MPC guidance. We further demonstrate rapid adaptation to different object geometries and successful goal-conditioned reorientation, showing that the framework enables efficient, low-intervention, real-world dexterous RL.

摘要（中文）：现实世界中的强化学习（RL）为灵巧操作策略提供了一条有前景的路径，使策略能够直接从物理交互中适应，但学习过程受到早期探索效率低下和代价高昂的失败的影响。我们提出了一种框架，将基于采样的模型预测控制（MPC）作为现实世界灵巧强化学习的支撑结构，在学习过程中提供结构化的先验经验和任务导向的指导，而无需人工示范或纠正动作。首先使用少量MPC轨迹填充离线回放缓冲区，并对演员和评论家网络进行预训练。在在线学习过程中，MPC间歇性地引导数据采集，同时离线策略的软演员-评论家学习器从先前的MPC经验和新建的物理交互中共同训练，控制权逐步过渡到学习到的策略。在16自由度Allegro手进行的连续手内旋转任务中，该方法在仅策略评估中达到100%成功率（5/5次试验），在线强化学习仅需7分钟，此前在硬件上采集20条MPC轨迹耗时12分钟作为初始化。在线训练过程中平均仅发生约三次物体掉落。经过20分钟的在线学习后，策略的旋转速度达到MPC控制器的五倍以上，并能在超过110分钟内完成1000次连续旋转而无一次掉落。消融实验表明，基于MPC的预训练、保留的MPC经验以及在线MPC指导具有互补性收益。我们进一步展示了该方法对不同物体几何形状的快速适应以及成功的目标条件重定向能力，表明该框架能够实现高效、低干预的现实世界灵巧强化学习。

Authors: Emek Barış Küçüktabak, Karankumar Patel, Zhaodong Yang, Jinda Cui, Kazuhiro Sasabuchi, Jun Takamatsu

ResSafe: Learning Safety Filtering with Residual Reinforcement Learning for Humanoids HumanoidEmbodied

residual reinforcement learning safety filtering humanoid control Pareto trade-off

简要说明：本文提出利用残差强化学习作为人形机器人隐形安全滤波器，将任务性能与安全性解耦，以改善性能-安全帕累托前沿。

TLDR: This paper proposes using residual reinforcement learning to act as an implicit safety filter for humanoid locomotion, decoupling task performance from safety to improve the performance-safety Pareto frontier.

Abstract: Safe control of humanoid robots remains challenging due to their high-dimensional dynamics, contact-rich interactions, and sensitivity to disturbances. Although reinforcement learning has enabled effective locomotion and motion tracking, learned policies can still generate unsafe actions that lead to instability or falls. In this work, we propose residual reinforcement learning as an implicit safety-filtering mechanism for safe humanoid control. Instead of relying on a single nominal policy to simultaneously balance performance, safety, and robustness, we decouple performance and safety. The nominal policy focuses solely on task performance, while a residual policy learns safety corrections. This decoupling leads to a better performance--safety Pareto trade-off and avoids the need for careful tuning of multiple competing reward terms within a single policy training. We show that the residual policy can act as an implicit safety filter.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人的安全控制因其高维动力学、接触丰富的交互以及对扰动的敏感性而依然具有挑战性。尽管强化学习已实现有效的运动控制和轨迹跟踪，但学习到的策略仍可能产生导致不稳定或跌倒的不安全动作。在本工作中，我们提出将残差强化学习作为隐式安全过滤机制，用于人形机器人的安全控制。我们不再依赖单一标称策略同时兼顾性能、安全性和鲁棒性，而是将性能与安全性解耦。标称策略仅专注于任务性能，而残差策略则学习安全修正。这种解耦实现了更好的性能-安全帕累托权衡，并避免了在单一策略训练中对多个相互竞争的奖励项进行精细调参的需求。我们证明残差策略能够充当隐式安全过滤器。

Authors: Gechen Qu, Tong Zhang, Bike Zhang, Yen-Jen Wang, Koushil Sreenath, Claire Tomlin, Jason Jangho Choi

Touch2Trace: Tactile-Driven Imitation Learning for Dexterous Cable Tracing Manipulation

tactile-driven imitation learning dexterous manipulation deformable objects behavior cloning transformer policy

简要说明：Touch2Trace 提出了一种触觉驱动的模仿学习系统，用于灵巧的线缆追踪任务，通过自监督触觉编码器和 transformer 策略实现了 93% 的成功率和零样本迁移，优于仅依赖本体感觉的基线。

TLDR: Touch2Trace introduces a tactile-driven imitation learning system for dexterous cable tracing, achieving 93% success rate and zero-shot transfer using a self-supervised tactile encoder and transformer policy, outperforming proprioception-only baselines.

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation of deformable objects demands continuous fingertip-level regulation of pressure, friction, and incipient slip. We study one of the most challenging cases: dexterous cable tracing, feeding a cable through the hand with repeated pinch-and-curl motions of the thumb and index finger. We introduce Touch2Trace, a tactile-driven imitation-learning system for this task, and provide, to our knowledge, the first systematic real-world characterization of how encoder pretraining, control rate, temporal context, and spatial resolution each shape policy performance. The winning learning recipe combines a tactile encoder pretrained for a custom 32 x 32 piezoresistive sensor (TacV5) via self-supervised learning with a lightweight transformer policy trained on teleoperated demonstrations via behavior cloning, deployed at 60 Hz on a Tesollo DG-5F hand. Tactile feedback without vision or explicit cable-state estimation significantly improves tracing performance versus a proprioception-only baseline: from 0.2 cm to 20.1 cm mean distance and 0% to 93% success rate, with zero-shot transfer to unseen cables and routing conditions. The results quantify the influence of key parameters in tactile-driven systems for reliable dexterous deformable object manipulation.

摘要（中文）：对可变形物体的灵巧操作要求在指尖层面持续调节压力、摩擦力及初始滑移。我们研究了其中最具挑战性的场景之一：灵巧线缆追踪——通过拇指与食指反复执行捏合与卷曲动作，将线缆引过手掌。我们提出了Touch2Trace，一种面向该任务的触觉驱动模仿学习系统，并据我们所知，首次系统性地在真实世界中刻画了编码器预训练、控制频率、时间上下文和空间分辨率各自对策略性能的影响。最优学习方案结合了针对自研32×32压阻传感器（TacV5）经自监督学习预训练的触觉编码器，以及基于遥操作演示通过行为克隆训练的轻量级Transformer策略，并以60 Hz频率部署在Tesollo DG-5F机械手上。相较于仅依赖本体感觉的基线，无需视觉或显式线缆状态估计的触觉反馈显著提升了追踪性能：平均距离从0.2厘米提升至20.1厘米，成功率从0%提升至93%，并能零样本泛化至未见过的线缆与布线条件。实验结果量化了触觉驱动系统中关键参数对可靠灵巧可变形物体操作的影响。

Authors: Matteo Grimaldi, David Klee, Ziling Chen, Tong Jian, Wonju Lee, Wenjie Lu, Tao Yu, Saleh Nabi

SlipSense: Multimodal Tactile Learning for Low-Latency and Generalized Slip Detection Manipulation

tactile slip detection multimodal fusion zero-shot transfer dexterous manipulation low-latency detection

简要说明：SlipSense 提出了一种基于压阻阵列和加速度计的多模态触觉滑移检测框架，实现了低延迟检测和跨平台的零样本泛化，适用于灵巧操作。

TLDR: SlipSense introduces a multimodal tactile slip-detection framework using a piezoresistive array and accelerometer, achieving low-latency detection and zero-shot cross-platform generalization for dexterous manipulation.

Abstract: Slip detection is fundamental to dexterous manipulation, yet existing systems often lack precise characterization of detection latency and cross-platform generalization. We present SlipSense, a multimodal tactile slip-detection framework built on TacV5, a compact sensor integrating a $32 \times 32$ piezoresistive array operating at 240 Hz and a 3-axis MEMS accelerometer operating at 8 kHz. The piezoresistive array captures spatial pressure distributions, while the accelerometer captures friction-induced vibrations, providing complementary slip cues. The framework performs modality-specific encoding, intra-sensor fusion, and cross-modal attention with causal temporal prediction at 240 Hz. Experiments on a dataset of 1.4 million frames spanning 37 objects demonstrate the complementarity of the two modalities. SlipSense achieves 96.7% Macro F1 with a false-positive rate below 1.6%, detecting 76% of slip events within 23.1 ms. When trained solely on UMI data, SlipSense generalizes zero-shot to a Tesollo dexterous hand, transferring across unseen objects, distinct sensor units, and robotic platforms without retraining.

摘要（中文）：滑动检测对于灵巧操作至关重要，然而现有系统往往缺乏对检测延迟和跨平台泛化能力的精确刻画。我们提出SlipSense，一种基于TacV5的多模态触觉滑动检测框架，该传感器集成了一个以240 Hz运行的$32 \times 32$压阻阵列和一个以8 kHz运行的三轴MEMS加速度计，结构紧凑。压阻阵列捕获空间压力分布，而加速度计捕获摩擦引起的振动，二者提供互补的滑动线索。该框架执行模态特定编码、传感器内融合以及带有因果时间预测的跨模态注意力机制，工作频率为240 Hz。在涵盖37个对象、共计140万帧的数据集上的实验表明，两种模态具有互补性。SlipSense实现了96.7%的宏F1分数，假阳性率低于1.6%，能够在23.1毫秒内检测到76%的滑动事件。当仅在UMI数据上训练时，SlipSense能够零样本泛化至Tesollo灵巧手，无需重新训练即可跨未见对象、不同传感器单元及机器人平台迁移。

Authors: Tong Jian, Aditya Thurvas Senthil Kumar, Xinyi Li, Ziling Chen, Tianyu Dai, Ali Sengul, Matteo Grimaldi, Wenjie Lu, Saleh Nabi, Tao Yu

Uncertainty-Guided Sparse Refinement for Action Chunking Transformer Policies Manipulation

action chunking uncertainty-guided refinement visuomotor policy dual-arm manipulation residual correction

简要说明：UGR提出了一种用于动作块视觉运动策略的稀疏细化框架，通过不确定性估计选择并仅修正最不确定的时间步，从而提高了双臂操作任务的成功率。

TLDR: UGR introduces a sparse refinement framework for action-chunking visuomotor policies, using uncertainty estimation to select and correct only the most uncertain timesteps, which improves success rates on dual-arm manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Learning chunk-based visuomotor policies for long-horizon robot manipulation remains challenging. Recent action-chunking methods have shown promising performance by predicting temporally extended action sequences. However, their failures are often dominated by prediction errors at a small number of critical timesteps rather than uniformly poor predictions across the entire action chunk, making uniform refinement inefficient and insufficiently targeted. To address this bottleneck, we propose Uncertainty-Guided Refinement (UGR), a sparse refinement framework for chunk-based visuomotor policies. Specifically, UGR follows a coarse-to-refine design: it first predicts a full action chunk, estimates per-step temporal uncertainty from the coarse hidden states, and applies residual correction only to the most uncertain timesteps selected by a binary mask. The uncertainty branch is decoupled from the coarse action predictor, enabling clean attribution of the refinement gains to uncertainty-guided correction rather than additional predictor capacity. Extensive experiments on five dual-arm manipulation tasks from the RoboTwin benchmark show that UGR achieves the best success rate on four tasks, improves over the ACT baseline by up to 13% absolute, and outperforms both full-chunk and position-agnostic block refinement in ablation studies.

摘要（中文）：基于块状视觉运动策略的长期机器人操作学习仍具挑战性。近期，动作分块方法通过预测时间上延展的动作序列展现了良好性能。然而，这类方法的失败往往集中在少数关键时间步的预测误差上，而非整个动作块上均匀分布的预测偏差，这使得均匀细化既低效又缺乏针对性。针对这一瓶颈，我们提出了一种基于不确定性引导的细化方法（UGR），一种用于基于分块的视觉运动策略的稀疏细化框架。具体而言，UGR采取了由粗到精的设计：首先预测完整的动作块，从粗粒度隐状态中估计每个时间步的时间不确定性，并仅对由二值掩码选出的最不确定时间步进行残差校正。不确定性分支与粗粒度动作预测器解耦，从而能够将细化增益清晰地归因于不确定性引导的校正，而非额外的预测器容量。在来自RoboTwin基准测试的五项双臂操作任务上的大量实验表明，UGR在其中四项任务上取得了最高成功率，相较ACT基线最高提升了13个百分点的绝对性能，并在此消融研究中优于全块细化及位置无关的块细化方法。

Authors: Chenyang Wang, Yuntian Wang, Xiaoxiong Yang, Dingde Jiang, Siao Liu, Yang Liu

JEPLO: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for LiDAR-Based Legged Locomotion Locomotion

joint-embedding predictive learning LiDAR-based legged locomotion world model teacher-student reinforcement learning sim-to-real transfer

简要说明：JEPLO提出了一种基于LiDAR的无地图腿式机器人运动单阶段学习框架，利用本体-外感受JEPA世界模型和并行教师-学生流程学习预测性地形表征，在多样地形上实现了稳健的仿真到现实迁移。

TLDR: JEPLO introduces a single-stage, mapping-free LiDAR-based locomotion framework for legged robots, using a proprio-exteroceptive JEPA world model and a concurrent teacher-student pipeline to learn predictive terrain representations, achieving robust sim-to-real transfer on diverse terrains.

Abstract: Light detection and ranging (LiDAR) remains less explored than RGB-D sensing for perceptive legged locomotion, and existing LiDAR-based approaches often rely on explicit mapping. We present JEPLO (Joint-Embedding Predictive learning for legged LOcomotion), a single-stage learning framework for mapping-free, LiDAR-based perceptive locomotion for legged robots. We introduce a proprio-exteroceptive JEPA (PE-JEPA) world model to learn predictive egocentric terrain representations from onboard observations, including raw LiDAR scans. A concurrent JEPA-teacher-student (CJTS) pipeline is further proposed to train a locomotion policy informed by JEPA latent representations in simulation using deep reinforcement learning with a simple reward formulation. The framework achieves successful sim-to-real transfer, enabling omnidirectional traversal of diverse terrains, including long staircases and high boxes, with lightweight onboard computation. Evaluations demonstrate greater robustness than existing perceptive locomotion frameworks, particularly under degraded perception caused by occlusion, sparsity and noise. Further analysis validates JEPLO's ability to retain task-relevant information under these challenging conditions. We open-source our implementation, experimental datasets, and hardware setup designs https://github.com/ASIG-X/JEPLO.

摘要（中文）：轻量级测距与雷达（LiDAR）在感知足式运动中的应用相较于RGB-D传感技术仍较为不足，且现有的基于LiDAR的方法通常依赖于显式地图构建。我们提出了JEPLO（基于联合嵌入预测学习的足式运动），这是一种用于足式机器人基于LiDAR、无需建图的感知运动的单阶段学习框架。我们引入了一种本体感觉-外部感觉联合嵌入预测架构（PE-JEPA）世界模型，用于从机载观测（包括原始LiDAR扫描）中学习预测性的自我中心地形表征。进一步提出了一种并行的JEPA教师-学生（CJTS）流水线，以在仿真中利用强化学习，在简单奖励公式下，训练由JEPA潜在表征引导的运动策略。该框架成功实现了仿真到实机的迁移，使机器人能够在多样化地形上实现全向穿越，包括长阶梯和高台，同时保持轻量级的机载计算。评估结果表明，该框架比现有感知运动框架具有更强的鲁棒性，尤其是在遮挡、稀疏和噪声导致的感知退化条件下。进一步的分析验证了JEPLO在这些挑战性条件下保留任务相关信息的能力。我们已开源我们的实现、实验数据集及硬件设计设置：https://github.com/ASIG-X/JEPLO。

Authors: Qihao Yuan, Yixuan Qiu, Ziyu Cao, Ming Cao, Kailai Li

Bench2Dex: Benchmarking Visuo-Tactile Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Across Dexterous Hands Manipulation

visuo-tactile bimanual manipulation dexterous hands simulation benchmark VLA policies

简要说明：Bench2Dex是一个跨12种灵巧手的视觉触觉双手灵巧操作仿真基准，提供一致的触觉接口、26个任务和人类演示，并评估了多种VLA策略。

TLDR: Bench2Dex is a simulation benchmark for visuo-tactile bimanual dexterous manipulation across 12 different dexterous hands, providing a consistent tactile interface, 26 tasks, and human demonstrations, along with evaluations of several VLA policies.

Abstract: Tactile sensing provides contact information that can be difficult to infer from vision alone, but tactile hardware for dexterous hands has not converged to a common design. Dexterous hands differ in finger structure, contact surfaces, and sensor layouts, while simulated tactile signals still differ from measurements produced by physical sensors. These factors make it difficult to study visuo-tactile manipulation across diverse dexterous hands within a consistent experimental setting. We present Bench2Dex, a simulation benchmark for visuo-tactile bimanual manipulation across 12 dexterous hands. We adapt existing robot models with a shared simulated tactile interface that converts local contact geometry into image-like tactile observations. The interface provides a consistent observation format across different hand morphologies without attempting to reproduce the output of a specific physical tactile sensor. Bench2Dex includes 26 bimanual manipulation tasks that involve tool use, articulated-object interaction, and multi-stage manipulation, together with about 1.3K human-teleoperated demonstrations. The benchmark provides synchronized visual, tactile, proprioceptive, action, and object-state observations, together with executable task metrics. For robustness, we group seven perturbation types into invariance axis, where the correct action does not change, and equivariance axis, where the correct action changes together with the perturbation. We evaluate ACT, Diffusion Policy, pi0.5, and GR00T N1.5 on Bench2Dex and report their performance and failure modes. Bench2Dex is meant as a platform for studying visuo-tactile learning across dexterous hands. It does not assume that simulated tactile observations can replace real tactile sensing; it offers a shared setting for algorithm development while tactile hardware and simulation models are still evolving.

摘要（中文）：触觉感知能够提供仅依靠视觉难以推断的接触信息，然而用于灵巧手的触觉硬件尚未收敛到通用设计。灵巧手在手指结构、接触表面和传感器布局方面各不相同，而仿真触觉信号与实际物理传感器产生的测量结果之间仍存在差异。这些因素使得在一致的实验环境中研究跨多种灵巧手的视觉-触觉操作变得困难。我们提出了Bench2Dex，一个涵盖12种灵巧手的视觉-触觉双臂操作仿真基准。我们为现有机器人模型适配了统一的仿真触觉接口，该接口将局部接触几何信息转换为类图像的触觉观测。该接口在不同手型之间提供一致的观测格式，而不试图复现特定物理触觉传感器的输出。Bench2Dex包含26项涉及工具使用、铰接物体交互和多阶段操作的双臂操作任务，以及约1300条人工遥操作演示。该基准提供同步的视觉、触觉、本体感觉、动作和物体状态观测，以及可执行的任务度量指标。为增强鲁棒性，我们将七种扰动类型分为不变性轴（正确动作不发生变化）和等变性轴（正确动作随扰动一同变化）。我们在Bench2Dex上评估了ACT、Diffusion Policy、pi0.5和GR00T N1.5，并报告了它们的性能和失败模式。Bench2Dex旨在作为跨灵巧手视觉-触觉学习的研究平台，它不假设仿真触觉观测能够替代真实触觉感知，而是在触觉硬件和仿真模型仍在发展演进的过程中，为算法开发提供一个共享的实验环境。

Authors: Zhenjie Yang, Yideng Zhang, Dongjie Zhang, Chenyu Jiang, Xianshuai Liu, Yufeng Li, Zuhao Ge, Xingyu Jiao, Zheng Zhang, Kaiyu He, He Wang, Yuwen Zhong, Yi Deng, Muyun Jiang, Xianliang Huang, Haisheng Su, Donghang Zhang, Jian Zhang, Xue Yang, Hongyang Li, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Xiaosong Jia, Junchi Yan

Flow-Matched Motion Priors: Online Optimal-Transport Rewards for Imitation Learning Locomotion

flow matching optimal transport motion priors imitation learning humanoid robot

简要说明：本文提出了流匹配运动先验（FMP），一种利用最优传输和流匹配将 rollout 历史连接到专家示范的标量奖励，在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上相比对抗和重心基线实现了更稳定、更快的行走。

TLDR: This paper introduces Flow-Matched Motion Priors (FMP), a scalar reward for imitation learning that uses optimal transport and flow matching to connect rollout histories to expert demonstrations, yielding more stable and faster locomotion on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot compared to adversarial and barycentric baselines.

Abstract: Learning a motion prior requires a reward that guides a policy from its current behavior toward demonstrated motion. Adversarial Motion Priors (AMP) provide such a reward with a discriminator. However, adversarial objectives can become uninformative when policy and expert supports are far apart. A naive use of optimal transport (OT) averages matched expert successors into a barycentric target. Averaging across gait phases can weaken the target's joint motion. We introduce Flow-Matched Motion Priors (FMP), an online scalar reward learned from paths connecting current rollout histories to an expert motion bank. Entropic OT supplies the coupling. Before each policy update, we train a neural potential with flow matching (FM) along the rollout-to-expert paths, endpoint-gradient supervision, and relative-value calibration. The actor receives only physical observations and the reward remains a scalar, as in AMP. Controlled reward-model experiments show substantially better generalization beyond the fitting rollout than value-only or endpoint-only fitting. On Unitree G1, matched 50-million-transition experiments compare FMP with AMP, a barycentric OT reward, and nested ablations under demonstration and fixed-pose initialization. FMP produces stable forward walking at 0.727 m/s from demonstration resets and 0.338 m/s from a fixed default pose. In the fixed-pose condition, it incurs 129 falls versus 243 for the endpoint-only control. Against a static score-gradient teacher, dynamic FM reduces score-increment error at interpolation fractions 0.25 and 0.50 while using 29% less offline fitting time.

摘要（中文）：学习运动先验需要一种奖励机制，以引导策略从当前行为朝向演示动作发展。对抗性运动先验（AMP）通过判别器提供此类奖励。然而，当策略分布与专家分布相距较远时，对抗性目标可能失去信息量。朴素地使用最优传输（OT）会将匹配到的专家后继状态平均为重心目标，而这种跨步态相位的平均可能削弱目标的关节运动。我们提出了流匹配运动先验（FMP），这是一种在线标量奖励，通过连接当前轨迹历史与专家动作库的路径进行学习，并采用熵正则化最优传输提供耦合。在每次策略更新前，我们训练一个神经势函数，通过流匹配（FM）沿轨迹到专家的路径进行训练，辅以端点梯度监督和相对值校准。与AMP相同，actor仅接收物理观测，奖励保持标量形式。受控奖励模型实验表明，相较于仅值函数或仅端点拟合，该方法在拟合轨迹之外的泛化能力显著更优。在Unitree G1上，匹配5000万次转移的实验将FMP与AMP、重心OT奖励及嵌套消融方法在演示初始化与固定姿态初始化条件下进行了对比。FMP在演示重置下实现了0.727 m/s的稳定前向行走，在固定默认姿态下实现了0.338 m/s。在固定姿态条件下，FMP发生129次摔倒，而仅端点对照组为243次。与静态评分梯度教师相比，动态流匹配在插值比例0.25和0.50处将得分增量误差降低了29%的离线拟合时间。

Authors: Yilin Zou, Chenghua Liu, Chenglong Wu, Fanghua Jiang

StereoPatch: Patch-Aligned RGB-Depth Fusion for Spatial Perception in Robot Manipulation Manipulation

RGB-depth fusion spatial perception robot manipulation visuomotor policies cross-attention

简要说明：StereoPatch 提出了一种将度量几何与RGB特征对齐的补丁级RGB-深度融合表示，用于机器人操作策略，在真实机器人和仿真任务中提升了闭环成功率。

TLDR: StereoPatch introduces a patch-aligned RGB-depth fusion representation that binds metric geometry to RGB features for robot manipulation policies, improving closed-loop success across real-robot tasks and simulation suites.

Abstract: Recent advances in robot imitation learning have produced visuomotor policies that predict actions directly from visual observations. Yet visually similar scenes can require different actions as target position, object height, or contact geometry changes. Pretrained RGB features may map these geometrically distinct states to similar policy inputs, while simply adding depth requires the policy to learn RGB-depth correspondence from the same limited demonstrations used to learn control. We introduce StereoPatch, a patch-aligned RGB-depth representation that binds registered metric geometry directly to the RGB patches used for action prediction. On a shared 2-D patch grid, asymmetric cross-attention incorporates depth information into the corresponding RGB features before action decoding. The resulting StereoPatch Tokens provide a geometry-aware visual representation that can condition general visuomotor policies without changing their underlying learning objectives. Across six real-robot tasks, StereoPatch achieves higher closed-loop success than appearance-only, geometry-only, raw RGB-D, and late-fusion baselines. Additional experiments across three simulation suites evaluate compatibility across visuomotor policy architectures, spatial generalization, and operating limits. Results suggest that resolving control-relevant geometric ambiguity benefits from aligning depth directly with the visual features used for action prediction, rather than supplying it as an independent modality. Project page: https://aus.bot/research/stereopatch/.

摘要（中文）：近年来，机器人类人学习领域的进展催生出了能够直接从视觉观测中预测动作的视觉-运动策略。然而，当目标位置、物体高度或接触几何发生变化时，视觉上相似的场景可能要求不同的动作。预训练的RGB特征可能将这些几何上不同的状态映射为相似的政策输入，而单纯添加深度信息则要求策略利用与学习控制相同的有限演示数据来学习RGB-深度对应关系。我们提出StereoPatch，一种补丁对齐的RGB-深度表示方法，它将配准的度量几何信息直接绑定到用于动作预测的RGB补丁上。在共享的二维补丁网格上，非对称交叉注意力在动作解码之前将深度信息整合到对应的RGB特征中。由此产生的StereoPatch令牌提供了一种几何感知的视觉表示，能够在无需改变其底层学习目标的情况下，对通用的视觉-运动策略进行条件化。在六个真实机器人任务中，StereoPatch取得了比仅外观、仅几何、原始RGB-D及晚期融合基线更高的闭环成功率。在三个仿真套件中的额外实验评估了其跨视觉-运动策略架构的兼容性、空间泛化能力以及操作极限。结果表明，解决与控制相关的几何歧义，关键不在于将深度作为独立模态提供，而在于将其与用于动作预测的视觉特征直接对齐。项目页面：https://aus.bot/research/stereopatch/。

Authors: Yanan Zhou, Zhaoyan Qian, James Zhao, Weiming Zhi

Learning to Exploit Passive Dynamics for Energy-Efficient Target Hopping of a Spring-Legged Quadcopter Locomotion

Passive dynamics PPO Energy-efficient hopping Spring-legged quadcopter Real robot control

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于PPO的直接状态到电机控制策略，用于弹簧腿四旋翼的目标跳跃，通过利用被动动力学提高能效，相比调优的PID基线，电能消耗降低了30.7%。

TLDR: This paper presents a PPO-based direct state-to-motor control policy for a spring-legged quadcopter, which improves energy efficiency in target hopping by exploiting passive dynamics, reducing electrical power use by 30.7% compared to a tuned PID baseline.

Abstract: Combining aerial thrust with spring-loaded hopping makes monopedal quadcopters promising for locomotion over complex terrain, but heuristic proportional-integral-derivative (PID) tuning limits coordination between active thrust and passive contact dynamics. We present a direct estimated-state-to-motor Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) policy that commands four motors without an explicit hopping state machine or low-level attitude PID. Its reward combines Energy-Manifold Shaping for mass-normalized vertical-energy tracking and apex-state anchoring with Efficiency Shaping, which uses a history-aware power estimator to penalize general power use, impose an additional airborne-power cost, and penalize airborne near-stationarity. In representative hardware runs, the PPO-based control stack reduced cycle-averaged measured electrical power by 30.7% and mean total normalized thrust by 49.8% relative to the tuned PID-based control stack, while retaining repeatable commanded-height hopping and more concentrated landings. These observations are consistent with improved use of passive dynamics and reduced measured electrical demand.

摘要（中文）：结合空中推力与弹簧弹跳，使得单足四旋翼飞行器在复杂地形上的移动展现出巨大潜力，但启发式比例-积分-微分（PID）参数调整限制了主动推力与被动接触动力学之间的协调。我们提出了一种直接从估计状态到电机的近端策略优化（PPO）策略，无需明确的跳跃状态机或底层姿态PID即可控制四个电机。其奖励机制结合了能量流形塑造，用于质量归一化的垂直能量追踪和顶点状态锚定，以及效率塑造，后者利用具有历史意识的功率估计器来惩罚整体功率使用，附加空中功率成本，并惩罚空中近静止状态。在代表性硬件实验中，与调优的基于PID的控制栈相比，基于PPO的控制栈将周期平均实测电功率降低了30.7%，平均总归一化推力降低了49.8%，同时保持了可重复的指令高度跳跃和更集中的着陆。这些观察结果与被动动力学的更好利用及实测电力需求的减少相一致。

Authors: Ruigang Chen, Qi Zhang, Zhicheng Zhong, Zhuorui Yun, Yizhar Or, Mingyi Liu

From Prediction to Decision: World-Model-Guided Action Selection for Continuous Pile Excavation Manipulation

world model action selection wheel-loader excavation autonomous excavation closed-loop control

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于自主轮式装载机挖掘的世界动作模型（WAM），通过物理结构化的预测器实时对候选挖掘动作进行排序，在仿真和真实系统上显著提升了效率和完成率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a World-Action Model (WAM) for autonomous wheel-loader excavation, which uses a physics-structured predictor to rank candidate scooping actions in real time, demonstrating significant improvements in efficiency and completion rate over baseline policies in simulation and on a real system.

Abstract: Wheel-loader excavation is a sequential decision problem in which every scoop changes the terrain available to subsequent actions. A practical world model must predict action consequences accurately, rank candidates in real time, and operate inside the closed loop of a full-size machine. We present the World-Action Model (WAM), which proposes multiple scoops, rejects geometrically inadmissible candidates, jointly predicts signed terrain change and loaded volume, executes the candidate with the largest predicted load, and replans from the newly observed terrain. On 32 geometry-disjoint MinSlope test episodes, adding world-model ranking to matched diffusion proposals reduces the mean scoop count from 651.8 to 540.6 (17.1%), preserves 32/32 completion, and improves every paired episode. In a complete-system comparison, WAM completes 32/32 episodes versus 29/32 for an independently trained soft actor-critic policy. Comparisons of input representations, spatial support, and five architectures identify an accurate and efficient physics-structured predictor. We further evaluate the interface on event-disjoint full-size-loader data and deploy the complete perception-proposal-prediction-selection-execution loop for autonomous excavation. The ROS2/TensorRT implementation processes five candidates in 72.4 ms on a Jetson AGX Orin. The simulation results establish decision-level gains, while the physical experiments demonstrate real-world closed-loop feasibility.

摘要（中文）：轮式装载机挖掘是一个序贯决策问题，其中每一次铲取都会改变后续动作所面临的地形。一个实用的世界模型必须准确预测动作后果，实时对候选方案进行排序，并在全尺寸机器的闭环内运行。我们提出了世界-动作模型（WAM），该模型生成多个铲取方案，剔除几何上不可行的候选方案，联合预测符号化地形变化和装载量，执行预测装载量最大的候选方案，并根据新观测到的地形重新规划。在32个几何不相交的MinSlope测试场景中，将世界模型排序与匹配的扩散提案相结合，平均铲取次数从651.8次减少至540.6次（降低17.1%），保持了32/32的完成率，并且每个配对场景均有所改进。在完整系统对比中，WAM完成了32/32个场景，而独立训练的软演员-评论家策略仅完成了29/32个场景。通过对输入表示、空间支撑及五种架构的比较，我们确定了一种准确且高效的物理结构化预测器。我们进一步在事件不相交的全尺寸装载机数据上评估了该接口，并部署了完整的感知-提案-预测-选择-执行闭环，用于自主挖掘作业。ROS2/TensorRT实现可在Jetson AGX Orin上于72.4毫秒内处理五个候选方案。仿真结果确立了决策层面的增益，而物理实验则验证了现实世界闭环的可行性。

Authors: Ailing Zhang, Fan Gao, Song Zhang, Kawa Leong, Ziyu Wu, Yafei Wang

Planning in the Backbone: DiffAdapterVLA for Native Continuous Trajectory Generation with Driving VLMs AutonomousDriving

driving VLM trajectory planning DiffAdapter closed-loop planning NAVSIM

简要说明：DiffAdapterVLA 将轨迹令牌注入VLM深层，实现连续闭环驾驶规划，在NAVSIM上验证了高效且高质量的结果。

TLDR: DiffAdapterVLA injects trajectory tokens into VLM late layers for continuous closed-loop driving planning, showing efficient adaptation and strong NAVSIM results.

Abstract: Pretrained driving vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual, route, language, and driving context into rich driving priors, yet their representation objectives remain separated from continuous driving planning. Existing methods typically begin trajectory generation only after the VLM has formed a final condition, leaving depth-wise condition computation outside the stepwise formation of trajectory state. We introduce DiffAdapterVLA, which realizes Planning in the Backbone: it injects explicit trajectory tokens into selected VLM late layers, bringing trajectory state into backbone forward computation, where it co-evolves with driving conditions at different depths. Lightweight layer-wise DiffAdapters organize this computation into recursive trajectory refinement, while asymmetric joint attention preserves directed guidance from the condition stream to trajectory planning. By placing planning within existing backbone computation rather than relying on an independent trajectory planner, DiffAdapterVLA adapts only lightweight trajectory modules to turn existing driving priors into efficient continuous planning capability. NAVSIM results show that it achieves high-quality closed-loop planning with low end-to-end latency using few trainable parameters, and demonstrate that jointly evolving trajectory state and depth-wise driving conditions in VLM late-layer computation effectively realizes continuous trajectory planning.

摘要（中文）：预训练驾驶视觉语言模型（VLM）将视觉、路线、语言及驾驶情境整合为丰富的驾驶先验知识，但其表征目标与连续驾驶规划仍相互分离。现有方法通常仅在VLM形成最终条件之后才开始轨迹生成，导致深度维度的条件计算未能融入轨迹状态的逐步形成过程。我们提出DiffAdapterVLA，实现了“主干网络内规划”（Planning in the Backbone）：将显式轨迹令牌注入选定的VLM深层网络，使轨迹状态参与主干网络的前向计算，并在不同深度上与驾驶条件协同演化。轻量化的逐层DiffAdapter将该计算组织为递归式轨迹精化，同时非对称联合注意力机制保持了从条件流到轨迹规划的定向引导。通过将规划嵌入现有主干网络计算而非依赖独立轨迹规划器，DiffAdapterVLA仅需适配轻量轨迹模块，即可将既有驾驶先验转化为高效的连续规划能力。NAVSIM实验结果表明，该方法以少量可训练参数实现了高质量闭环规划及低端到端延迟，并验证了在VLM深层计算中联合演化轨迹状态与深度维度驾驶条件可有效实现连续轨迹规划。

Authors: Changxin Lu, Xiaoliang Meng, Yu Wu, Rui Huang, Honglin Li, Tao Chen, Kaixuan Zhou, Yadong Shao

PredTac: Learning Contact-Rich Manipulation with Predicted Touch Manipulation

predicted touch tactile prediction contact-rich manipulation visuotactile policy ACT

简要说明：PredTac 从视觉和机器人状态观测中学习预测触觉状态，并将预测的触觉作为接触丰富的操作策略的输入，在真实机器人上无需触觉传感器即可实现与实测触觉策略相当的性能。

TLDR: PredTac learns to predict tactile states from visual and robot-state observations, using the predicted touch as an input to contact-rich manipulation policies, achieving near parity with measured-touch policies on real robots without tactile sensors.

Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation benefits from tactile feedback, yet physical tactile sensors introduce hardware, calibration, synchronization, and maintenance costs that complicate policy learning and deployment. We formulate predicted touch as an alternative to measured tactile input and present PredTac, a framework that learns to infer tactile states from causal visual observations and robot states and uses the predicted touch as an explicit interface for policy learning and execution. A tactile predictor is first trained with tactile supervision and then used to provide contact information without requiring measured tactile input during downstream policy training or execution. We evaluate PredTac across three contact-rich manipulation tasks in simulation and on a real robot, and further examine how policy performance depends on the predicted contact content. In simulation goal-offset evaluations, predicted-touch policies achieve 27.0%, 52.0%, and 44.7% success on USB, Barbed-spike, and Valve, respectively, improving over the visual baseline by 8.0-13.7 percentage points. On the real robot, predicted-touch ACT achieves 70.0%, 50.0%, and 90.0% success on USB insertion, Barbed extraction, and Valve rotation, respectively, with a three-task mean of 70.0%, approaching measured-touch ACT at 72.2% and substantially outperforming visual ACT at 21.1%. Fixed-policy interventions further show that performance is sensitive to the spatial structure of predicted contact, with spatial rearrangement at fixed value distributions reducing Valve success by 10.7 percentage points. These results demonstrate that predicted touch can provide useful contact information for contact-rich manipulation without requiring tactile sensing as a policy input.

摘要（中文）：接触丰富的操作任务受益于触觉反馈，然而物理触觉传感器引入了硬件、标定、同步及维护成本，使策略学习与部署变得更加复杂。我们将预测触觉（predicted touch）作为实测触觉输入的替代方案，提出PredTac框架，该框架从因果视觉观测和机器人状态中学习推断触觉状态，并将预测触觉作为策略学习与执行的显式接口。首先利用触觉监督训练一个触觉预测器，随后在下游策略训练或执行过程中，无需实测触觉输入即可提供接触信息。我们在仿真环境和真实机器人上对PredTac进行了三项接触丰富操作任务的评估，并进一步考察了策略性能对预测接触内容的依赖程度。在仿真目标偏移评估中，基于预测触觉的策略在USB插入、倒刺拔出和阀门旋转任务上分别达到27.0%、52.0%和44.7%的成功率，相较纯视觉基线提高了8.0至13.7个百分点。在真实机器人上，预测触觉ACT在USB插入、倒刺拔出和阀门旋转任务上分别达到70.0%、50.0%和90.0%的成功率，三项任务平均成功率为70.0%，接近实测触觉ACT的72.2%，并显著优于纯视觉ACT的21.1%。固定策略干预实验进一步表明，策略性能对预测接触的空间结构敏感，在固定数值分布的条件下对空间排列进行重排会使阀门任务成功率下降10.7个百分点。上述结果表明，预测触觉无需将触觉传感作为策略输入即可为接触丰富的操作任务提供有效的接触信息。

Authors: Weijia Fan, Daqiang Guo

HarnessVLN: Unifying Training-Free Embodied Navigation through an Agent Harness VLN

training-free Agent Harness Spatiotemporal Graph multimodal large language models embodied navigation

简要说明：HarnessVLN 提出了一个零样本、无需训练的框架，通过代理控制装置（Agent Harness）验证多模态大语言模型规划器的提议与空间证据和几何可行性，并集成时空图记忆用于导航，在 R2R、RxR、HM3D-v2 和 HM3D-OVON 基准上取得了领先成果，并实现了人形机器人部署。

TLDR: HarnessVLN proposes a zero-shot, training-free framework with an Agent Harness that validates MLLM planner proposals against spatial evidence and geometric feasibility, and integrates a Spatiotemporal Graph memory for navigation, achieving SOTA results on R2R, RxR, HM3D-v2, and HM3D-OVON benchmarks, plus humanoid deployment.

Abstract: Embodied navigation requires agents to interpret visual observations, accumulate spatial knowledge, and execute actions to follow instructions or locate objects. Training-based methods face generalization challenges, while training-free methods exploit multimodal large language models (MLLMs) but often lack mechanisms to reconcile proposed actions with spatial evidence, task progress, and execution failures. We present HarnessVLN, a zero-shot, training-free framework whose Agent Harness coordinates perception, retrieval, grounding, navigation, recovery, and termination through a unified tool interface. The Harness validates planner proposals against spatial evidence, geometric feasibility, and subgoal consistency, incorporating structured tool feedback into subsequent decisions. Hierarchical event memory tracks task progress and execution history, while a persistent Spatiotemporal Graph maintains reusable spatial evidence and failure annotations for verification and recovery. A replaceable Navigation Executor converts validated targets into executable motions, allowing the same Harness protocol to support instruction-following and object-goal navigation. HarnessVLN achieves success rates of 60.8%, 53.9%, 76.0%, and 59.3% on R2R, RxR, HM3D-v2, and HM3D-OVON, respectively, surpassing prior training-free SOTA results. Humanoid deployment further demonstrates its applicability to both tasks in real-world environments. The project page is: https://harnessvln.netlify.app/.

摘要（中文）：具身导航要求智能体解读视觉观察、积累空间知识并执行动作以遵循指令或定位物体。基于训练的方法面临泛化挑战，而免训练方法利用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs），但往往缺乏将提议动作与空间证据、任务进展及执行失败进行调和的机制。我们提出HarnessVLN，一种零样本、免训练框架，其智能体控制系统（Agent Harness）通过统一工具接口协调感知、检索、 grounding、导航、恢复和终止过程。该系统依据空间证据、几何可行性和子目标一致性验证规划器提议，并将结构化工具反馈纳入后续决策。分层事件记忆追踪任务进展和执行历史，而持久化时空图维护可复用的空间证据和失败标注，用于验证与恢复。可替换的导航执行器将验证后的目标转换为可执行动作，使同一控制系统协议同时支持指令跟随和物体目标导航。HarnessVLN在R2R、RxR、HM3D-v2和HM3D-OVON上分别实现了60.8%、53.9%、76.0%和59.3%的成功率，超越了此前免训练的最先进结果。人形机器人部署进一步证明了其在真实环境中对两类任务的适用性。项目页面：https://harnessvln.netlify.app/。

Authors: Yang Chen, Lirong Che, Zhenyu Huang, Wenbo Fu, Chuang Wang, Xu Cao, Daqi Liu, Yuzhe Yang, Jian Su, Lan-Zhe Guo

C$^2$Nav: Compare Before You Commit for Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation VLN

Zero-shot VLN-CE Vision-language models Comparative model-robot interface Gaze Election R2R-CE

简要说明：C2Nav 是一种用于连续环境中零样本视觉语言导航的免训练框架，将 VLM 的基数输出替换为对控制器构建的备选方案进行比较，在 R2R-CE 上取得了优异性能，并表明这种接口与 VLM 推理能力互补。

TLDR: C2Nav is a training-free framework for zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation in continuous environments that replaces cardinal VLM outputs with comparative choices over controller-constructed alternatives, achieving strong results on R2R-CE and demonstrating that this interface complements VLM reasoning.

Abstract: Zero-shot vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE) increasingly places foundation vision-language models (VLMs) inside the navigation loop. Existing systems commonly request cardinal outputs such as waypoints, pixels, headings, progress values, or absolute arrival decisions, coupling a generative response to geometric magnitude or an irreversible commitment. We study a complementary model-robot interface: the VLM compares controller-constructed alternatives, while geometry, thresholds, action magnitude, and execution remain on the physical side. We instantiate this idea in C2Nav, a training-free framework with three coordinated faculties. Seeing performs ordinal Gaze Election over physically vetted candidate views; Remembering maintains a compact route sketch and compares adjacent instruction-leg hypotheses; and Arriving combines a hesitation ladder, look-back comparison, and revocable walk-back for reliable stopping. On the public OpenNav R2R-CE 100 protocol, C2Nav with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct obtains 41.0% OSR, 31.0% SR, and 16.7% SPL, while the same interface with the standard GPT-5.5 model reaches 54.0% OSR, 44.0% SR, and 29.0% SPL. Whole-faculty ablations reduce SR to 14.0% without Seeing, 25.0% without Remembering, and 29.0% without Arriving. Matched role inversions that replace only the comparative answer form with cardinal/absolute questions reduce SR to 12.0%, 28.0%, and 21.0% in the spatial, transition, and terminal slots, respectively. The results indicate that a constrained decision interface and stronger VLM reasoning are complementary rather than interchangeable.

摘要（中文）：在连续环境中的零样本视觉与语言导航（VLN-CE）正日益将基础视觉语言模型（VLM）嵌入导航循环之中。现有系统通常要求输出类别化结果，如路径点、像素、朝向、进度值或绝对到达判定，从而将生成式响应与几何量值或不可逆的决策绑定。我们研究了一种互补的模型-机器人接口：由VLM对控制器构建的候选方案进行比较，而几何计算、阈值判断、动作幅度及执行过程则保留在物理侧。我们将这一思想具体化为C2Nav，一个无需训练的框架，包含三项协同功能模块：视觉模块通过物理筛选后的候选视角执行序数性注视投票（Gaze Election）；记忆模块维护紧凑的路线草图并比较相邻指令段假设；到达模块结合犹豫阶梯、回望比较及可撤销的回退机制，以可靠地实现停止判定。在公开的OpenNav R2R-CE 100协议上，采用Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct的C2Nav取得了41.0%的OSR、31.0%的SR和16.7%的SPL，而同一接口配合标准GPT-5.5模型则达到54.0%的OSR、44.0%的SR和29.0%的SPL。全模块消融实验中，去除视觉模块后SR降至14.0%，去除记忆模块后降至25.0%，去除到达模块后降至29.0%。将各模块中的比较式答案替换为类别化/绝对式问题后，空间、过渡及终止槽位的SR分别降至12.0%、28.0%和21.0%。结果表明，受限的决策接口与更强的VLM推理能力是互补关系，而非可互换关系。

Authors: Runtian Zheng, Congpeng Zhang, Ying Liu

LG-VLN: A Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation Framework with LangGraph State Orchestration VLN

Vision-and-Language Navigation Zero-shot LangGraph Monocular CleanDIFT

简要说明：LG-VLN是一种零样本单目VLN-CE框架，利用共享CleanDIFT特征和基于LangGraph的状态编排，在R2R-CE验证集上实现21.3%成功率，提高了空间语义一致性和导航性能。

TLDR: LG-VLN is a zero-shot monocular VLN-CE framework that uses shared CleanDIFT features and LangGraph-based state orchestration to achieve 21.3% success on R2R-CE val-unseen, improving spatial-semantic consistency and navigation.

Abstract: Continuous-environment vision-and-language navigation (VLN-CE) requires interpreting natural-language instructions in unseen 3D environments and executing continuous low-level actions. Existing methods often depend on LiDAR, panoramic cameras, or extra sensors; separate geometric-mapping and semantic-navigation visual representations can cause long-trajectory spatial-semantic inconsistencies. We propose LG-VLN, a monocular zero-shot framework with shared visual features and LangGraph-based state orchestration. An online feed-forward 3D reconstruction network predicts depth, camera poses, and dense point clouds for agent-pose estimation and global map fusion. Geometry and navigation share dense CleanDIFT features: semantic consistency rejects incorrect inter-frame correspondences, while target-instance constraints define visual references whose similarity combines with local BLIP-2 image-text relevance to form a semantic value map. LangGraph represents instruction parsing, geometric perception, semantic value updates, path planning, action execution, and failure recovery as a directed state graph with conditional transitions, persistent state, and modular recovery mechanisms. On a fixed 550-episode subset of the R2R-CE val-unseen split, LG-VLN achieves 21.3% success and 12.1% success weighted by path length. Ablations show shared semantic features improve navigation, further boosted by combining visual similarity and image-text relevance. Results establish shared visual representations and explicit state orchestration as effective for zero-shot VLN-CE using monocular RGB alone. Code will be publicly released for reproducibility.

摘要（中文）：连续环境视觉与语言导航（VLN-CE）要求在未见过的三维环境中理解自然语言指令，并执行连续的低层动作。现有方法通常依赖激光雷达、全景相机或额外传感器；将几何建图与语义导航的视觉表示分离，可能导致长轨迹中的空间-语义不一致。我们提出LG-VLN，一种基于共享视觉特征与LangGraph状态编排的单目零样本框架。在线前馈三维重建网络预测深度、相机位姿及稠密点云，用于智能体位姿估计与全局地图融合。几何与导航共享稠密CleanDIFT特征：语义一致性拒绝错误的帧间对应关系，同时目标实例约束定义视觉参考，其相似度与局部BLIP-2图像-文本相关性相结合，构成语义价值图。LangGraph将指令解析、几何感知、语义价值更新、路径规划、动作执行及失败恢复表示为带条件转移的有向状态图，具备持久状态与模块化恢复机制。在R2R-CE验证未见分割的固定550个片段子集上，LG-VLN实现了21.3%的成功率和12.1%的按路径长度加权成功率。消融实验表明，共享语义特征可提升导航性能，结合视觉相似度与图像-文本相关性后进一步提升。结果表明，共享视觉表示与显式状态编排对仅使用单目RGB的零样本VLN-CE有效。代码将公开发布以供复现。

Authors: Jianhe Zhao, Yanhua Qiu, Zhiyu Zhang, Zibo Zhao, Jinhua Xie

Steering Generative Robot Policies with Lexicographic Preferences Manipulation

lexicographic preferences diffusion policy flow matching inference-time steering barrier guidance

简要说明：本文通过对冻结的生成式机器人策略（扩散或流匹配）的推理采样器进行两项修改，以在不改变策略权重的情况下，强制执行按字典序排序的部署偏好。该方法在导航和操作基准上提高了成功率、可通行性和偏好符合度。

TLDR: This paper introduces two modifications to the inference-time sampler of frozen generative robot policies (diffusion or flow matching) to enforce lexicographically ordered deployment preferences, without changing policy weights. The method improves success, traversability, and preference compliance on navigation and manipulation benchmarks.

Abstract: Pretrained generative robot policies can produce effective behaviors across diverse environments, but deployment can lead to requirements and preferences that may not have been represented during training. Furthermore, at deployment, an operator, user, or application may assign these requirements and preferences a priority order that can vary across deployments. For example, embodiment-specific feasibility constraints may need to be satisfied first, while user-specific preferences guide behavior among the feasible options. We show that a frozen generative robot policy---based on either diffusion or flow matching---can be steered at inference time to respect such lexicographically ordered deployment objectives. To achieve this, we introduce two modifications to the sampler. First, we apply dynamic-barrier guidance to sampled trajectories, constraining lower-priority updates so that higher-priority costs do not increase (up to first order). Second, we select the executed sample using a cascade that successively filters candidate samples according to each priority level. The policy weights remain unchanged. On a navigation benchmark, we demonstrate that our method improves success, traversability, and preference compliance over the frozen policy, and achieves substantially better compliance than tuned weighted-sum baselines. The same method transfers to a flow-matching manipulation policy on LIBERO, where it improves compliance without reducing task success. A controlled manipulation study further shows that, in settings where a fixed weight can match the desired ordering, the dynamic barrier reaches comparable best performance over a substantially wider range of parameter settings.

摘要（中文）：预训练生成式机器人策略能够在多种环境中产生有效行为，但在部署时可能面临训练期间未表示的需求和偏好。此外，在部署阶段，操作员、用户或应用可能会为这些需求和偏好分配优先级顺序，且该顺序可能随部署场景而变化。例如，特定于具身形态的可行性约束可能需要首先满足，而用户特定偏好则用于在可行选项中引导行为。我们证明，一个冻结的生成式机器人策略——无论是基于扩散模型还是流匹配——都可以在推理时通过引导来遵循此类字典序排列的部署目标。 为实现这一点，我们对采样器引入了两项修改。首先，我们对采样轨迹应用动态障碍引导，约束低优先级更新，使高优先级成本不增加（直至一阶精度）。其次，我们使用一种级联方法依次根据各优先级级别筛选候选样本，从而选择最终执行的样本。策略权重保持不变。 在导航基准测试中，我们证明该方法在成功率、可通行性和偏好符合性方面优于冻结策略，并且相比调优的加权求和基线实现了显著更优的符合性。该方法同样适用于LIBERO上的流匹配操作策略，在不降低任务成功率的前提下提升了符合性。一项受控操作研究进一步表明，在固定权重能够匹配所需顺序的情况下，动态障碍方法在显著更广泛的参数设置范围内达到了可比的最佳性能。

Authors: Yixuan Jia, Jonathan P. How

Atomic Motion Coordinate for Language-Steerable and Force-Responsive Manipulation Manipulation

VLA Manipulation Motion Coordinate Force-Responsive Language-Steerable

简要说明：本文提出了原子运动坐标，一种基于几何的坐标，用于增强VLA策略的语言可操控性和力响应性，在真实机器人任务中取得了显著改进。

TLDR: This paper introduces Atomic Motion Coordinate, a geometry-grounded coordinate that enhances VLA policies for language-steerable and force-responsive manipulation, achieving significant improvements in real-robot tasks.

Abstract: Can changing only the language instruction redirect a VLA policy's end effector, or does the visually driven motion prior dominate? We present Atomic Motion Coordinate, a geometry-grounded coordinate for steerable and force-responsive manipulation. Each arm owns thirteen signed translation, rotation, and hold atoms grounded from text and forward kinematics with vision withheld, and the coordinate is injected into every action-expert block via weighted codebook alignment. Contact history modulates the same coordinate through a bounded spherical residual that is recomputed from a fixed nominal latent to regenerate only the unexecuted horizon suffix. Across 7,520 offline horizon interventions, opposite-atom separation reaches 92.5/83.1% (single/dual) versus 39.1/24.0% for LA4VLA-style. Across 50 real-robot trials per task, AMC raises OOD fruit progress from 60.5% to 87.8%; force adaptation raises Plug/Vase from 59.0/71.5% to 78.5/75.2%.

摘要（中文）：仅改变语言指令能否重定向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的末端执行器，还是视觉驱动的运动先验占据主导？我们提出原子运动坐标（Atomic Motion Coordinate），一种基于几何的可控且力响应的操作坐标。每只机械臂拥有十三种有符号的平移、旋转和保持原子，这些原子基于文本和前向运动学（不依赖视觉）构建，并通过加权码本对齐注入到每个动作专家模块中。接触历史通过一个有界的球面残差调制同一坐标，该残差从固定的名义潜变量重新计算，仅再生未执行的水平线后缀。在7，520次离线水平线干预中，相反原子分离率达到92.5/83.1%（单臂/双臂），而LA4VLA风格仅为39.1/24.0%。在每项任务的50次真实机器人试验中，AMC将超出分布（OOD）水果任务成功率从60.5%提升至87.8%；力适应将插拔/花瓶任务成功率从59.0/71.5%提升至78.5/75.2%。

Authors: Jiaqi Zhai, Jingkai Zhao, Chen Yang, Siyuan Ma, Yutian Zhang, Liwen Yang, Qinglian Wu, Weiqi Fan, Yifei Wang, Yi Zheng, Chenxi Gu, Dong Wei, Wei Zhang

PhysBrain 1.5: From Vision-Language Models to Physical Foundation Models VLA

vision-language-action physical foundation model autoregressive next-token prediction human interaction videos end-effector trajectory prediction

简要说明：PhysBrain 1.5 将物理理解、动作生成和未来状态预测统一到一个视觉语言模型中，通过将语言、末端执行器运动和视觉目标编码为离散序列，并在人类交互视频上预训练及机器人/模拟数据上微调，在具身理解基准上达到SOTA，并展示了机器人轨迹和未来场景预测的能力。

TLDR: PhysBrain 1.5 unifies physical understanding, action generation, and future-state prediction in a single vision-language model by encoding language, end-effector motion, and visual targets as discrete sequences, pretraining on human interaction videos, and fine-tuning on robot and simulation data, achieving SOTA on embodied understanding benchmarks and demonstrating qualitative robot trajectory and future-scene prediction.

Abstract: We present PhysBrain 1.5, a unified model for understanding physical environments, generating actions, and predicting future states. Motivated by the physical loop of observation, interaction, and environmental change, we bring these capabilities into a common learning framework. Starting from a general vision--language model, we encode language responses, end-effector motion, and dense visual targets as discrete sequences and jointly optimize them with autoregressive next-token prediction. Pre-training draws its embodied supervision entirely from human interaction videos, using task-centered episodes to pair semantic and spatial context with recovered motion and subsequent observations. We then adapt the model through supervised fine-tuning on a mixture of human demonstrations, robot trajectories, and simulated experience. Across 28 embodied understanding benchmarks, our 8B model achieves an average score of 72.5, setting a new open-source state of the art and performing on par with leading proprietary models such as GPT-6-Astra and Gemini 3.6 Flash. It achieves the best open-source results on 14 benchmarks while retaining general multimodal capabilities. Beyond these understanding evaluations, qualitative examples show the model's ability to produce end-effector trajectories and predict future scenes through spatially aligned RGB, depth, and robot-mask outputs.

摘要（中文）：我们提出PhysBrain 1.5，一个用于理解物理环境、生成动作并预测未来状态的统一模型。受“观察—交互—环境变化”这一物理回路的启发，我们将这些能力整合进一个共同的学习框架中。从一个通用的视觉—语言模型出发，我们将语言响应、末端执行器运动以及密集视觉目标编码为离散序列，并通过自回归的下一个词元预测对它们进行联合优化。预训练阶段的具身监督信号完全来源于人类交互视频，利用以任务为中心的情节片段，将语义与空间上下文同恢复的运动以及后续观测配对。随后，我们通过在人类示范、机器人轨迹和模拟经验混合数据上的监督微调来适配模型。在28个具身理解基准测试中，我们的8B模型平均得分达到72.5，创下开源模型的新纪录，并与GPT-6-Astra和Gemini 3.6 Flash等领先的专有模型表现相当。它在14个基准测试中取得了最优开源结果，同时保留了通用多模态能力。除了这些理解评估外，定性示例还展示了该模型通过空间对齐的RGB、深度和机器人掩码输出生成末端执行器轨迹并预测未来场景的能力。

Authors: DeepCybo Team, Yu Bin, Haipeng Cao, Zheng Chang, Kai Chen, Youning Chen, Kailin Deng, Yichao Du, Xiaotong Fu, Haoyang Ge, Yunlong Guo, Chenliu Hao, Jiyan He, Xuguo He, Yakun Hou, Kai Hu, Cong Huang, Tuopusen Huang, Yu Huang, Hong Li, Peize Li, Shijie Lian, Xiaopeng Lin, Yun Lin, Haibao Liu, Haochen Liu, Qiuzhi Liu, Shengcai Liu, Zhiqiang Liu, Tao Luo, Peng Ren, Shuo Ren, Chaoyi Ruan, Zhaolong Shen, Yukun Shi, Qiyuan Su, Yuxuan Tian, Yining Wang, Changti Wu, Hao Wu, Xueyin Xu, Ruoqi Yang, Zhaoyang Yang, Hang Yuan, Zhaoyang Zeng, Hanwen Zhang, Ruimeng Zhang, Yao Zhang, Yibo Zhang, Yuxiang Zhang, Zhirui Zhang, Ziyi Zhang, Zubin Zheng, Zishen Zhuang

When the World Lies: Backdoor Attacks on Latent World Models for Downstream Control WorldModel

backdoor attack latent world models supply-chain downstream control Dreamer-style actor

简要说明：本文提出了一种针对预训练潜在世界模型的供应链后门攻击，通过注入恶意检查点，使下游控制器在干净数据训练和评估下仍被劫持，且在清洁诊断中不被发现。攻击在多个控制任务中有效，触发观测可引导动作至攻击者目标，且中等微调难以修复。

TLDR: This paper introduces a new supply-chain backdoor attack on pretrained latent world models, where a poisoned checkpoint can hijack downstream controllers without the victim seeing explicit triggers, while passing clean-data diagnostics. The attack is shown across control tasks, with trigger-bearing observations steering actions toward attacker targets and remaining hidden to moderate fine-tuning.

Abstract: Pretrained world models, learned simulators that encode an observation into a latent state and predict how it evolves under actions, are beginning to be reused as off-the-shelf dynamics backbones for control, like pretrained encoders and language models are reused today. We show that this reuse opens a supply-chain backdoor: an adversary who controls only a released checkpoint can hijack the downstream controller, even though the victim trains and evaluates entirely on clean data and never sees the trigger. The attack encodes no explicit trigger-to-action rule. Instead, the poisoned model routes trigger-bearing observations into a chosen latent region and reshapes the local dynamics there, so that the victim's own optimization (Dreamer-style actor training in imagination, or MPC/CEM planning over predicted futures) re-discovers the attacker's target action on its own. Across several control tasks and trigger families, the trigger steers the controller's action toward the attacker's target, controlling every action dimension and hijacking 100\% of triggered steps on the strongest settings. The checkpoint still passes the clean-data diagnostics a victim would run before deployment, with clean-task success retaining at least $\sim$75\%. The effect is temporally gated: it appears only while the trigger is present and disappears when the trigger is removed. Trigger-blind repair is budget-dependent: moderate clean fine-tuning can preserve clean utility while leaving the triggered failure intact, whereas sufficiently aggressive adaptation can remove it only after substantially degrading clean control. The world-model backbone itself is therefore an emerging and underexamined attack surface for control. The full code and artifacts are available in our repository.

摘要（中文）：预训练世界模型——一种学习型模拟器，将观测编码为潜在状态，并预测其在动作作用下的演化——正开始像今天的预训练编码器和语言模型一样，被复用为控制任务的现成动力学骨干。我们表明，这种复用打开了一个供应链后门：仅控制一个已发布检查点的攻击者即可劫持下游控制器，即使受害者完全在干净数据上训练和评估，且从未见过触发器。该攻击并未编码显式的触发器到动作的规则。相反，被投毒的模型将携带触发器的观测路由到选定的潜在区域，并在该区域重塑局部动力学，从而使受害者自身的优化过程（Dreamer风格的想象中智能体训练，或基于预测未来轨迹的MPC/CEM规划）自行重新发现攻击者的目标动作。在多个控制任务和触发器族中，触发器将控制器的动作导向攻击者的目标，在最强设定下控制每个动作维度并劫持100%的触发步。该检查点仍能通过受害者在部署前会运行的干净数据诊断，干净任务成功率至少保持在约75%。该效应具有时间门控特性：仅在触发器存在时出现，移除触发器后即消失。对触发器不知情的修复依赖于预算：适度的干净微调可以在保留干净效用的情况下使触发故障保持完整，而足够激进的适配只有在显著退化干净控制后才能消除该故障。因此，世界模型骨干本身正成为控制任务中一个新兴且未得到充分审视的攻击面。完整代码和工件可在我们的仓库中获取。

Authors: Roberto Riaño, Gorka Abad, Stjepan Picek, Aitor Urbieta

DuctAM: A Duct-Assisted Quadrotor-Based Aerial Manipulator Enabling High-Force Push-and-Pull Interactions Manipulation

aerial manipulation ducted fans push-and-pull attitude-force decoupled control quadrotor

简要说明：本文提出DuctAM，一种带涵道风扇的旋翼空中机械臂，提升了水平推拉力量，并通过解耦控制方案和真实实验验证了其有效性。

TLDR: The paper presents DuctAM, a quadrotor-based aerial manipulator with ducted fans for enhanced horizontal push-and-pull force, along with a decoupled control scheme, validated through real-world experiments.

Abstract: Uncrewed Aerial Manipulators (UAMs) extend the capabilities of Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) from perception to physical interaction. Among various aerial interactions, push-and-pull operations are fundamental manipulation primitives that require sustained horizontal forces while maintaining stable flight. In this paper, we propose DuctAM, a compact aerial manipulation platform that enhances horizontal force capability for push-and-pull interactions using two ducted fans integrated along the quadrotor interaction axis. An attitude-force decoupled control scheme enables controllable horizontal forces without requiring large attitude changes. Extensive real-world experiments are conducted to validate the DuctAM. Figure-eight trajectory tracking experiments demonstrate stable flight and accurate motion control in both quad and duct modes. Force-measurement experiments quantify the decoupled longitudinal force capability of DuctAM. Finally, representative push-and-pull interaction tasks, including cart pushing, door closing, and drawer opening, verify the practical effectiveness of DuctAM. The results show that DuctAM achieves significantly improved horizontal interaction force capability while maintaining stable flight compared with conventional UAVs.

摘要（中文）：无人空中操纵器（UAMs）将无人飞行器（UAVs）的能力从感知拓展至物理交互。在各种空中交互任务中，推拉操作是基本的操纵单元，要求在执行持续水平力的同时保持稳定飞行。本文提出DuctAM，一种紧凑型空中操纵平台，通过沿四旋翼交互轴集成两个涵道风扇，增强了推拉交互中的水平力能力。所设计的姿态-力解耦控制方案能够在无需大幅姿态变化的情况下产生可控水平力。为验证DuctAM的性能，进行了大量实际实验。八字轨迹跟踪实验表明，在四旋翼模式和涵道模式下均能实现稳定飞行与精确运动控制。力测量实验量化了DuctAM解耦后的纵向力能力。最后，通过具有代表性的推拉交互任务，包括推车、关门和开抽屉，验证了DuctAM的实际有效性。结果表明，与传统无人机相比，DuctAM在保持稳定飞行的同时，显著提升了水平交互力能力。

Authors: Yi Wang, Rui Jin, Xinhang Xu, Haotian Jin, Ruiyang Liu, Yizhuo Yang, Lihua Xie

Continuous Manifold-Decomposed Impedance Retargeting for Contact-Rich Imitation Learning Manipulation

impedance retargeting variable-impedance control imitation learning contact-rich manipulation FastMPO

简要说明：CMDIR将阻抗重定向扩展为连续变阻抗控制器，用于接触丰富的模仿学习，在真实机器人试验中提高了任务代理保留率并降低了力，同时通过FastMPO实现了更快的优化。

TLDR: CMDIR extends impedance retargeting to continuous variable-impedance controllers for contact-rich imitation learning, improving task proxy retention and reducing forces in real robot trials, with faster optimization via FastMPO.

Abstract: CMDIR extends Manifold-Decomposed Impedance Retargeting (MDIR) to transform fixed-impedance demonstrations into continuous variable-impedance controllers, which can also serve as structured supervision for imitation learning. Continuous Task-Manifold Impedance Representation (TMIR) pairs an evolving task frame with controller instructions. Demo-relative Compromise dynamics retain moving-basis transport and control/physical metric mismatch, yielding displacement, reaction-impulse, and perturbation-sensitivity criteria. Quality-to-Fast automatically compiles a solver structure from development paths within a predefined finite space, re-instantiates that structure for each demonstration, and certifies the resulting candidate by multi-resolution evaluation. Across 225 retargeted-controller trials in three real contact tasks, full CMDIR improves mean task-proxy retention and reduces mean pose deviation, force fluctuation, and peak force relative to discrete MDIR. FastMPO achieves a $5.8$--$9.4\times$ speedup over C-MPO with comparable closed-loop outcomes. Downstream experiments demonstrate learnability of the complete TMIR supervision interface; lower force fluctuation and peak force are observed among successful executions, while completion reliability remains uneven across tasks and environments.

摘要（中文）：CMDIR将流形分解阻抗重定向（MDIR）扩展为将固定阻抗演示转化为连续变阻抗控制器，该控制器亦可作为模仿学习的结构化监督信号。连续任务流形阻抗表示（TMIR）将演化中的任务坐标系与控制器指令配对。基于演示的相对折中动力学保留了移动基座传输与控制/物理度量不匹配，从而产生位移、反作用冲量及扰动敏感性判据。Quality-to-Fast在预定义有限空间内根据开发路径自动编译求解器结构，为每次演示重新实例化该结构，并通过多分辨率评估对所得候选解进行认证。在三个真实接触任务的225次重定向控制器试验中，完整的CMDIR相较于离散MDIR，在平均任务代理保持率上有所提升，同时降低了平均位姿偏差、力波动及峰值力。FastMPO相较于C-MPO实现了$5.8$--$9.4$倍的加速，且闭环结果相当。下游实验验证了完整TMIR监督接口的可学习性；在成功执行中观察到较低的力波动和峰值力，但各任务及环境间的完成可靠性仍不均衡。

Authors: Jiahao Liu, Kento Kawaharazuka, Tasuku Makabe, Kei Okada

Volumetric Harmonic Field Navigation for Quadrotors Locomotion

quadrotor navigation harmonic potential fields predictive planning collision avoidance trajectory optimization

简要说明：本文展示了体积调和场导航在物理四旋翼上的首次验证，通过将预计算的调和场与受约束的预测规划器耦合，在杂乱环境中实现无碰撞且平滑的轨迹。

TLDR: This paper presents the first physical quadrotor demonstration of volumetric harmonic field navigation, coupling a precomputed harmonic field with a constrained predictive planner for collision-free and smooth trajectories in cluttered environments.

Abstract: Quadrotor navigation in cluttered 3-D environments requires global guidance while local motion remains subject to collision and motion limits. Harmonic potentials provide dense guidance from a global boundary value problem, but coupling a volumetric harmonic field to constrained physical quadrotor motion remains an open experimental problem. We couple a precomputed volumetric harmonic field with a constrained predictive planner that queries the field at predicted positions instead of extracting a global reference path. In Structured 3-D tests, harmonic guidance yields larger minimum clearance and lower RMS jerk than matched Dijkstra guidance, at the cost of longer paths; the same pattern remains when both methods use the same passage. Long maze tests span routes far beyond one prediction horizon, and Crazyflie trials validate physical execution. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first physical quadrotor demonstration of volumetric harmonic field navigation. The results show that globally constructed harmonic guidance can directly support local constrained motion generation on a physical quadrotor.

摘要（中文）：在杂乱三维环境中的四旋翼导航需要全局引导，而局部运动仍受碰撞和运动限制的约束。调和势能通过全局边值问题提供密集引导，但将体积调和场与受限的物理四旋翼运动相结合仍是一个未解决的实验问题。我们将预计算的体积调和场与受限预测规划器耦合，该规划器在预测位置查询调和场，而非提取全局参考路径。在结构化三维测试中，与匹配的Dijkstra引导相比，调和引导实现了更大的最小间隙和更低的均方根加加速度，但代价是路径更长；当两种方法使用相同通道时，这一模式保持不变。长迷宫测试覆盖了远超一个预测范围的路径，Crazyflie实验验证了实际飞行执行。据我们所知，这是体积调和场导航在物理四旋翼上的首次演示。结果表明，全局构建的调和引导能够直接支持物理四旋翼上的局部受限运动生成。
