Authors: Shuxiu Jia, Amartya Mukherjee, Yating Yuan, Jun Liu

Dynamics-Informed Reinforcement Learning for Agile and Energy-Efficient Locomotion of a Monopedal Hopping Quadcopter Locomotion

Dynamics-Informed RL monopedal hopping energy-efficient locomotion agile gait MuJoCo simulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种面向单足跳跃四旋翼机器人的动力学信息强化学习框架，通过嵌入目标比能和相位一致性奖励，在仿真中实现了敏捷且节能的跳跃步态。

TLDR: This paper proposes a Dynamics-Informed Reinforcement Learning framework for a monopedal hopping quadcopter, embedding target specific energy and phase-consistency rewards to achieve agile, energy-efficient hopping in simulation.

Abstract: Although aerial-legged robots offer combined agility and efficiency, controlling high-speed hopping under complex hybrid dynamics is challenging. Reinforcement Learning (RL) is promising but prone to energy-inefficient "reward hacking". We propose a Dynamics-Informed RL framework for a monopedal hopping quadcopter. By embedding a target Specific Energy into the reward, we constrain the optimization to a physically viable energy manifold, ensuring stable hopping behaviour. By rewarding the phase-consistent behavior, it can encourage bio-inspired stance-phase impulse. Furthermore, penalizing the electro-mechanical power waste induces the motors generate an efficient impulse. This enables the policy to inject energy strictly during spring restitution without heuristic state machines. MuJoCo simulations validate robust height regulation and forward velocity tracking up to 2.0 m/s despite severe attitude-contact coupling. Ultimately, our approach yields a highly agile hopping gait, reducing energy consumption by 82% and 73% compared to hovering baselines and inefficiency baseline, respectively.

摘要（中文）：尽管空中腿部机器人兼具敏捷性与能效，但在复杂混合动力学条件下控制高速跳跃仍具挑战性。强化学习（RL）虽前景广阔，却容易产生低能效的“奖励黑客”行为。我们提出了一种面向单腿跳跃四旋翼的动力信息强化学习框架。通过将目标比能嵌入奖励函数，我们将优化约束在物理可行的能量流形上，从而确保稳定的跳跃行为。通过奖励相位一致行为，可促进仿生支撑相冲量。此外，对机电功率浪费进行惩罚，促使电机产生高效冲量。这使得策略能够在无需启发式状态机的情况下，严格在弹簧恢复阶段注入能量。MuJoCo仿真验证了在严重姿态-接触耦合下，系统仍能实现稳健的高度调节及最高2.0 m/s的前向速度跟踪。最终，该方法实现了高度敏捷的跳跃步态，与悬停基线和低效基线相比，能耗分别降低了82%和73%。

Authors: Ruigang Chen, Qi Zhang, Zhicheng Zhong, Zhuorui Yun, Yizhar Or, Mingyi Liu

Understanding User Preferences of a Slope-Aware Variable-Admittance Filter for a Robot Guide Dog Locomotion

robot guide dog variable-admittance filter slope-aware adaptation human-robot interaction quadruped robot

简要说明：本文研究了一种用于机器人导盲犬的坡度感知可变导纳滤波器，根据地形坡度调整刚度和阻尼以改善用户在进行力交互引导时的偏好，并通过仿真和人体实验验证。

TLDR: This paper studies a slope-aware variable-admittance filter for a robot guide dog, tuning its stiffness and damping based on terrain slope to improve user preferences during force-based physical guidance, validated with simulations and a human-subject study.

Abstract: This letter investigates how the parameters of a slope-aware variable-admittance filter influence user preferences in force-based interaction with a robotic guide dog for visually impaired individuals. The proposed system consists of a quadruped robot equipped with a sensor-free rigid handle for physical guidance. The framework combines path following, momentum-based interaction-wrench estimation, and a variable-admittance filter whose stiffness and damping are adapted online from slope information extracted by the robot's depth camera. The adaptation policies are evaluated through high-fidelity simulations and a human-subject study involving blindfolded sighted participants. Multiple strategies are compared using a Taguchi L9 design of experiments. Preliminary main-effect results suggest that increasing stiffness uphill and decreasing it downhill improves both objective and subjective metrics, whereas damping shows no significant main effect.

摘要（中文）：本信研究了斜坡感知可变导纳滤波器的参数如何影响视障人士与机器人导盲犬进行力交互时的用户偏好。所提出的系统由一个配备无传感器刚性手柄的四足机器人组成，用于物理引导。该框架结合了路径跟踪、基于动量的交互力估计，以及一个可变导纳滤波器，其刚度和阻尼根据机器人深度相机提取的斜坡信息进行在线调整。通过高保真仿真和涉及蒙眼视力正常参与者的受试者研究，对自适应策略进行了评估。采用田口L9实验设计比较了多种策略。初步主效应结果表明，上坡时增大刚度、下坡时减小刚度能够改善客观和主观指标，而阻尼未表现出显著的主效应。

Authors: Federico Esposito, Mario Selvaggio, Aaron Link, Fabio Ruggiero

Assistance Torque Estimation via Dynamics-Aware Optimization for Lower-Limb Exoskeleton in Complex Environments Locomotion

assistance torque estimation dynamics-aware optimization lower-limb exoskeleton data-driven prediction metabolic reduction

简要说明：本文提出一种基于动力学感知优化的辅助扭矩估计方法，用于下肢外骨骼，替代昂贵动作捕捉系统，并训练数据驱动网络实现复杂环境下的实时预测，显著降低代谢率、心率和肌肉激活。

TLDR: This paper proposes a dynamics-aware optimization method to estimate assistance torque for lower-limb exoskeletons, replacing costly motion capture systems, and trains a data-driven network for real-time prediction in complex environments, demonstrating significant reductions in metabolic rate, heart rate, and muscle activation.

Abstract: Ground-truth human joint torque estimation relies on motion capture systems, which suffer from limited outdoor usability and significant deployment expenses. Furthermore, direct scaling of ground-truth joint torques to obtain motor torque commands is not necessarily the optimal strategy. To address the aforementioned limitations, inspired by the human motion generation process, this paper proposes a novel assistance torque estimation method based on the dynamic model. From an optimization perspective, the proposed method directly generates motor-assist torque and lowers the cost of data acquisition. Then, a data-driven assistance torque prediction network is trained to enable accurate real-time prediction under complex outdoor environments. Experimental results demonstrate that optimized (estimated) assistance torque exhibits better phase consistency with gait trajectories and better alignment with task characteristics. Relative to the Zero torque condition, the predicted torque can decrease metabolic rate by 11.8%-17.7%, heart rate by 8.9%-14.3%, and peak muscle activation levels by 28.2%-54.0%, respectively. This provides a new perspective for low-cost adaptive exoskeleton assistance.

摘要（中文）：地面真实人体关节力矩估算依赖于动作捕捉系统，但该系统在户外环境中的可用性有限，且部署成本高昂。此外，直接按比例缩放地面真实关节力矩以生成电机力矩指令，未必是最优策略。为克服上述局限，本文受人体运动生成过程的启发，提出了一种基于动力学模型的辅助力矩估算新方法。从优化角度来看，该方法可直接生成电机辅助力矩，并降低了数据采集成本。随后，训练了一个数据驱动的辅助力矩预测网络，以实现复杂户外环境下精准的实时预测。实验结果表明，优化（估算）所得的辅助力矩与步态轨迹具有更好的相位一致性，且与任务特性更为契合。相较于零力矩条件，预测力矩可使代谢率降低11.8%至17.7%，心率降低8.9%至14.3%，峰值肌肉激活水平降低28.2%至54.0%。这为低成本自适应外骨骼辅助提供了一种新的视角。

Authors: Xiao-Yin Liu, Guotao Li, Weiqun Wang, Zeng-Guang Hou

A Vision Based Framework Integrating Attention and Action Cues for Interpretable Cognitive Workload Assessment in Human-Robot Collaborative Assembly Manipulation

human-robot collaboration cognitive workload assessment vision-based attention-action framework RGB-D

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于视觉的注意力-动作框架，用于人机协作装配中的可解释认知工作负载评估，利用RGB-D观测和机器人状态推断工作负载，无需佩戴额外传感器，并在变速箱装配实验中进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a vision-based attention-action framework for interpretable cognitive workload assessment in human-robot collaborative assembly, using RGB-D observations and robot states to infer workload without body-worn sensors, validated in a gearbox assembly experiment.

Abstract: The introduction of human-robot collaboration (HRC) in industrial assembly operations is revolutionizing the manufacturing landscape. In this evolving environment, operators are required to seamlessly coordinate their manual tasks with real-time task information and robotic behaviors. These demands fluctuate during operation, yet conventional workload assessments depend on body-worn physiological sensors that complicate practical deployment. Here, we present a vision-based attention--action framework for continuous and interpretable workload-related assessment in HRC assembly. The framework combines RGB-D observations with robot states and calibrated task-related areas to construct a temporally confirmed representation of operator behavior. This representation identifies where task demand is concentrated and explains how it develops when attention and action diverge, the task context changes, or the operator hesitates. We evaluated the framework in a three-level collaborative gearbox assembly experiment with ten participants, using subjective ratings and synchronized physiological signals as independent references. Raw NASA-TLX ratings confirmed increasing perceived workload across conditions, with significant effects on overall workload and its mental and temporal dimensions. The vision-derived HRC-CWL output was significantly associated with ECG-derived features in seven of nine participants with complete correlation data. Synchronized interaction episodes further showed temporal correspondence between detected hesitation and physiological activity. Real-time deployment demonstrated that the framework can operate without requiring operators to wear additional sensors. These findings support HRC-CWL as an interpretable behavioral proxy for cognitive ergonomics analysis and adaptive robot assistance, rather than a direct psychophysiological measure of workload.

摘要（中文）：人机协作（HRC）在工业装配作业中的引入正在彻底改变制造业格局。在这一不断演进的环境中，操作人员需要将其手动任务与实时任务信息和机器人行为无缝协调。这些需求在操作过程中不断波动，而传统的工作负荷评估依赖体戴式生理传感器，这在实际部署中较为复杂。本文提出了一种基于视觉的注意力-行动框架，用于在HRC装配中实现连续且可解释的工作负荷相关评估。该框架将RGB-D观测数据与机器人状态及标定的任务相关区域相结合，构建操作人员行为的时序确认表征。该表征能够识别任务需求集中所在，并解释当注意力与行动分离、任务情境变化或操作人员犹豫时，需求如何演变。我们在一个包含十名参与者的三级别协作式齿轮箱装配实验中评估了该框架，并使用主观评分和同步生理信号作为独立参考。原始NASA-TLX评分证实了不同条件下感知工作负荷的逐步增加，且对总体工作负荷及其心理和时间维度均有显著影响。在九名具有完整相关性数据的参与者中，有七名的视觉衍生HRC-CWL输出与ECG衍生特征显著相关。同步交互片段进一步显示，检测到的犹豫与生理活动之间存在时间上的对应关系。实时部署表明，该框架无需操作人员佩戴额外传感器即可运行。这些发现支持HRC-CWL作为认知工效学分析和自适应机器人辅助的可解释行为代理指标，而非工作负荷的直接心理生理学测量工具。

Authors: Junyan Xiong, Naiyi Feng, Xingke Xia, Qihang Fan, Suchang Chen, Daqiang Guo

LieSpline-DP: Lie-Group B-Spline Diffusion Policy for Smooth Robot Manipulation Manipulation

Diffusion Policy SE(3) B-spline C2 continuity robot manipulation

简要说明：LieSpline-DP 提出了一种基于李群 B 样条的扩散策略，在 SE(3) 上生成末端执行器轨迹并保证跨块 C^2 连续性，在真实机器人操作任务中提高了平滑性和成功率。

TLDR: LieSpline-DP proposes a Lie-group B-spline diffusion policy that generates end-effector trajectories on SE(3) with guaranteed cross-chunk C^2 continuity, improving smoothness and success rates on real robot manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Diffusion Policy (DP) is a powerful Learning from Demonstration (LfD) method for robotic manipulation, yet it suffers from discontinuous and non-smooth trajectories. Spline-based action representations promote smooth motion within individual action chunks, but existing spline-based methods neither guarantee cross-chunk $C^2$ continuity nor account for the group structure of $\mathrm{SE}(3)$. We therefore propose LieSpline-DP, a Lie-group B-spline diffusion policy that generates end-effector trajectories directly on $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ and couples consecutive plans by sharing their boundary control poses, ensuring $C^2$ continuity throughout the entire planned trajectory. Across three real-robot tasks, LieSpline-DP produces lower trajectory jerk and higher task success rates than the DP baseline. The gains are particularly pronounced in real-world tasks involving liquids and flexible objects: in our real-robot experiments, LieSpline-DP achieved a 100% success rate on both pouring and bucket hooking, whereas the DP baseline achieved only 10% and 30%, respectively.

摘要（中文）：扩散策略（DP）是一种用于机器人操作任务的示范学习（LfD）强大方法，但其生成的轨迹存在不连续且不平滑的问题。基于样条的动作表示能够在单个动作片段内促进平滑运动，但现有的基于样条的方法既不能保证跨片段的\(C^2\)连续性，也未考虑\(\mathrm{SE}(3)\)群的群结构。为此，我们提出了LieSpline-DP，一种李群B样条扩散策略，直接在\(\mathrm{SE}(3)\)上生成末端执行器轨迹，并通过共享边界控制位姿将相邻计划耦合，从而在整条规划轨迹上确保\(C^2\)连续性。在三个真实机器人任务中，LieSpline-DP相较于DP基线产生了更低的轨迹加加速度和更高的任务成功率。在涉及液体和柔性物体的真实世界任务中，这一优势尤为显著：在真实机器人实验中，LieSpline-DP在倾倒和桶钩挂两项任务上均实现了100%的成功率，而DP基线分别仅达到10%和30%。

Authors: Erxuan Xie, Bang Liu, Pingyun Nie, Xingkai Liu, Zhuang Fu, Bo Zhang

Legislating World-Model-Based Planning with Legal Reasoning WorldModel

world models legal reasoning Defeasible Deontic Logic motion planning robot normative control

简要说明：本文提出了一种法律规划栈，利用可废止道义逻辑约束运动规划器，并借助学习的世界模型实现机器人的事前治理。在模拟机器人臂上的实验表明，立法约束提高了法律遵守度，同时识别并量化了接地同构和本体同构差距。

TLDR: This paper proposes a legal planning stack that uses Defeasible Deontic Logic to constrain a motion planner, leveraging learned world models for ex ante governance of robot behavior. It demonstrates on a simulated robot arm that legislative constraints improve legal abidance, while identifying and measuring grounding and ontological isomorphism gaps.

Abstract: As robotic systems grow more general, legal norms are needed to integrate them into society. This paper extends the isomorphism problem of aligning legal source texts with their encodings, and measures two key challenges to robot normative control: (1) the \textit{grounding isomorphism gap}, where perception error grounds false atoms for legal reasoning, and (2) the \textit{ontological isomorphism gap}, where one legal conclusion admits many faithful translations into planning constraints. The paper introduces a legal planning stack that employs Defeasible Deontic Logic (DDL) to constrain a motion planner. The stack leverages learned world models to plan and to provide legal context, enabling \textit{ex ante} governance that intervenes before an illegal action is executed. It was deployed on a simulated robot arm pushing a cube across a $3\times3$ grid. The findings were (1) the legislated agent abided substantially more often than the non-legislated one, and modeling perception uncertainty lifted abidance even further, (2) the legal reasoning ran efficiently at runtime and its verdicts were auditable, and (3) the stack adapted to exogenous signals and endogenous rule changes. Both gaps were measured: (4) world model and probe error corrupted the factual input for the DDL reasoner, and (5) a single law admitted several faithful metric interpretations yielding drastically different abidance. Thus, \textit{ex ante} legislation functions as intended, and closing these gaps with a standardized mapping from the law to runtime constraints and improved fact grounding from perception will yield robust laws that align robot behavior with society's norms.

摘要（中文）：随着机器人系统日益通用化，需要制定法律规范以将其融入社会。本文扩展了法律源文本与其编码之间对齐的同构问题，并衡量了机器人规范控制面临的两大关键挑战：（1）** grounding同构缺口**，即感知错误为法律推理提供了虚假原子；（2）**本体论同构缺口**，即同一法律结论可被翻译为多种忠实的规划约束。本文提出了一种法律规划栈，采用可废止道义逻辑（DDL）来约束运动规划器。该规划栈利用学习到的世界模型进行规划并提供法律背景，从而实现“事前”治理，即在非法行为执行之前进行干预。该系统部署于一个模拟机器人手臂上，在$3\times3$网格上推动立方体。研究结果如下：（1）受法律约束的智能体比未受约束的智能体更频繁地遵守法律，且对感知不确定性建模进一步提升了合规率；（2）法律推理在运行时高效执行，其裁决结果可审计；（3）该规划栈能适应外部信号和内部规则变化。两个缺口均被量化测量：（4）世界模型和探测误差污染了DDL推理器的事实输入；（5）单一法律可产生多种忠实的度量解释，导致合规率显著不同。因此，“事前”立法按预期发挥作用，而通过建立从法律到运行时约束的标准化映射以及改进基于感知的事实接地，将能产生稳健的法律，使机器人行为与社会规范保持一致。

Authors: Dylan Waldner, Yiannis Kantaros, Guido Governatori, Risto Miikkulainen, Amir Banifatemi

From Learned-Mode AV-Traffic Pairing to Planner Decisions: A Marginal-Preserving Study on Argoverse 2 AutonomousDriving

AV-traffic pairing marginal-preserving planner decisions Argoverse 2 motion forecasting

简要说明：该论文在Argoverse 2上通过保持边际分布不变的干预方法，研究了学习模式中的AV-交通配对是否影响规划器决策。结果表明，移除配对会改变规划器决策，但无法将这一效应与条件集中的变化分离开。

TLDR: The paper studies whether learned-mode AV-traffic pairing affects planner decisions in autonomous driving, using a marginal-preserving intervention on Argoverse 2. It finds that removing pairing changes planner decisions, but cannot separate the effect from changes in conditioned concentration.

Abstract: Joint motion forecasts pair each autonomous-vehicle (AV) future with surrounding traffic, but actor-level metrics do not show whether that structure matters to a planner. We study this question with a marginal-preserving product control that removes AV-traffic pairing among the learned modes while retaining the fixed constant-velocity pair and holding trajectories, actor-level marginals before planner conditioning, candidates, the cost terms and weights, and fallback fixed. The intervention also changes candidate-conditioned concentration. Across twelve runs on 1,400 held-out Argoverse 2 scenarios, the intervention changes 3.0% of route-level offline selections at $τ=4$ m. Control-minus-joint recorded-trajectory regret is $-0.026$ and $-0.118$ at the two training sizes; crossed and seed-$t$ intervals span zero. At $τ=1$ m, relative costs change in 87.9% of route evaluations and route-level offline selections in 8.1%. Before concentration matching, descriptive outcome estimates favor the control. Most of this gap disappears along an approximate concentration-matching path; the remaining contrasts are $+0.112$ and $-0.047$, and both crossed intervals span zero. Actor-level forecast metrics remain identical. Pairing-strength and temperature sweeps show that the decision contrast grows with pairing removal and sharper conditioning. The intervention changes planner decisions even though actor-level metrics remain unchanged. The matching analysis, however, cannot separate any recorded-outcome effect of learned-mode AV-traffic pairing from the accompanying change in conditioned concentration.

摘要（中文）：联合运动预测将每个自动驾驶车辆（AV）的未来轨迹与周围交通进行配对，但基于单个参与者的评估指标无法体现这种结构对规划器是否重要。我们通过一种保持边缘分布的产品控制方法来研究这一问题，该方法在去除学习模式中AV-交通配对的同时，保留固定的恒速配对和保持轨迹、规划器条件化前的参与者边缘分布、候选轨迹、成本项及权重以及回退策略不变。该干预措施还改变了候选条件化后的集中度。在1,400个留出的Argoverse 2场景上进行的十二次运行中，该干预在$τ=4$ m阈值下改变了3.0%的路线级离线选择。控制组减去联合组的记录轨迹遗憾值在两种训练规模下分别为$-0.026$和$-0.118$；交叉区间和种子-$t$区间均跨零。在$τ=1$ m阈值下，87.9%的路线评估中相对成本发生变化，8.1%的路线级离线选择发生变化。在集中度匹配之前，描述性结果估计偏向于控制组。沿近似集中度匹配路径，这一差距大部分消失；剩余的对比值为$+0.112$和$-0.047$，两个交叉区间均跨零。参与者级预测指标保持不变。配对强度和温度扫描显示，决策差异随配对移除和更尖锐的条件化而增大。尽管参与者级指标保持不变，该干预仍改变了规划器的决策。然而，匹配分析无法将学习模式中AV-交通配对的记录结果效应与伴随的条件化集中度变化分离开来。

Authors: Jingyu Wang

Primitive-Informed Sampling-Based MPC for Multi-Fingered Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

sampling-based MPC dexterous manipulation manipulation primitives model predictive control Allegro hand

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于原始动作信息采样的 MPC 框架，用于多指灵巧操作，通过低维操作原语引导采样并优化关节级残差，在实体 Allegro 手及 MuJoCo 数字孪生上验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a primitive-informed sampling-based MPC framework for multi-fingered dexterous manipulation, which biases sampling with low-dimensional manipulation primitives and optimizes joint-level residuals, validated on a physical Allegro hand with a MuJoCo digital twin.

Abstract: We present a primitive-informed sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) framework for multi-fingered dexterous manipulation. Sampling-based MPC avoids the need for gradients through complex contact dynamics, but direct exploration of the high-dimensional joint space is inefficient and makes performance strongly dependent on the sampling distribution. Our framework biases sampling using low-dimensional manipulation primitives that encode coordinated finger motions, while simultaneously optimizing joint-level residuals to adapt these motions to the current hand-object configuration. Task-related rollout constraints reject infeasible trajectories during forward simulation, improving the effective use of the sampling budget. We evaluate the approach on a physical Allegro hand using a synchronized MuJoCo digital twin. Ablations show that both the primitive and residual are necessary for reliable continuous in-hand rotation, that increasing the sampling budget alone does not recover this coordination, and that rollout constraints substantially improve success rate. A primitive extracted from a single object remains effective across object sizes and under model mismatch, and the framework further supports grasping, object reorientation, and coordinated arm-hand reach-grasp-transport, using primitives extracted from both a simulation-trained policy and human hand-motion data.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种基于原始动作的采样模型预测控制（MPC）框架，用于多指灵巧操作。采样型MPC无需通过复杂的接触动力学计算梯度，但直接在高维关节空间中进行探索效率低下，且性能强烈依赖于采样分布。该框架利用编码协调手指动作的低维操作原始动作来引导采样，同时优化关节级残差，以适应当前手-物体配置。任务相关的滚动时域约束在前向仿真过程中剔除不可行轨迹，从而提高采样预算的有效利用。我们在物理Allegro手上结合同步的MuJoCo数字孪生对方法进行了评估。消融实验表明，原始动作和残差对于可靠的连续手中旋转均不可或缺；单纯增加采样预算无法恢复这种协调性；滚动约束显著提高了成功率。从单一物体提取的原始动作在物体尺寸变化和模型失配情况下依然有效，该框架还支持抓取、物体重定向以及协调的手臂-手到达-抓取-搬运任务，所使用的原始动作既可来自仿真训练的策略，也可来自人手运动数据。

Authors: Emek Barış Küçüktabak, Karankumar Patel, Jinda Cui, Zhaodong Yang, Kazuhiro Sasabuchi, Jun Takamatsu

Language-Guided Representation Learning for Robust Cross-Sensor Material Recognition Perception3D

tactile representation learning language-guided distillation cross-sensor transfer vision-based tactile sensors few-shot learning

简要说明：本文提出一种语言引导的蒸馏框架，用于学习对传感器鲁棒的触觉表示，将来自不同视觉传感器的触觉图像与语言嵌入对齐。在多个触觉数据集上展示了少样本学习和跨传感器迁移的显著改进。

TLDR: This paper proposes a language-guided distillation framework to learn sensor-robust tactile representations for robots, aligning tactile images from different vision-based sensors with language embeddings. It demonstrates significant improvements in few-shot learning and cross-sensor transfer across multiple tactile datasets.

Abstract: Robots need touch to manipulate objects safely and reliably, as many properties, such as softness, texture, and contact stability, are hard to infer from vision alone. However, vision-based tactile sensors yield different observations of the same material due to variations in optics, elastomer properties, and illumination, leading to poor generalization when trained on a single or multiple sensors. We propose a language-guided distillation framework for learning sensor-robust tactile representations. Language encodes high-level semantic properties of touch (e.g., rough, soft, slippery) that remain invariant across sensing hardware, providing a natural sensor-agnostic supervisory signal. We construct a 39K-sample touch-language dataset with human-annotated material labels and train a tactile encoder to align sensor-specific tactile images with language embeddings in a shared semantic space. We evaluate our approach for few-shot learning and cross-sensor transfer and benchmark it on six existing tactile datasets. Our method achieves 95% accuracy in the 100-shot setting, improves cross-sensor transfer by an average of 13.3% accuracy, and yields up to 19% accuracy gains across six existing tactile datasets. These results demonstrate that language-guided distillation enables scalable and hardware-agnostic tactile representation learning. Code and dataset are available at https://mashood3624.github.io/Language_Tactile/

摘要（中文）：机器人需要触觉才能安全可靠地操作物体，因为柔软度、纹理和接触稳定性等许多属性难以仅凭视觉推断。然而，基于视觉的触觉传感器由于光学、弹性体特性和照明的差异，对同一种材料会产生不同的观测结果，导致在单个或多个传感器上训练时泛化能力较差。我们提出了一种语言引导的蒸馏框架，用于学习对传感器鲁棒的触觉表征。语言编码了触觉的高级语义属性（如粗糙、柔软、光滑），这些属性在不同传感硬件之间保持不变，从而提供了一种天然的、与传感器无关的监督信号。我们构建了一个包含39K样本的触觉-语言数据集，并配有专家标注的材料标签，训练了一个触觉编码器，将特定传感器的触觉图像与语言嵌入对齐到共享语义空间中。我们评估了该方法在少样本学习和跨传感器迁移中的表现，并在六个现有触觉数据集上进行了基准测试。我们的方法在100样本设置下达到了95%的准确率，跨传感器迁移准确率平均提高了13.3%，在六个现有触觉数据集上准确率最高提升了19%。这些结果表明，语言引导的蒸馏能够实现可扩展且与硬件无关的触觉表征学习。代码和数据集可在 https://mashood3624.github.io/Language_Tactile/ 获取。

Authors: Mashood M. Mohsan, Muhayy Ud Din, Binzhao Xu, Ahmad Abubakar, Irfan Hussain

A Personalized Dynamic Balance Evaluation Paradigm for Hip Exoskeleton-Assisted Walking under Unexpected Ground Perturbations Locomotion

hip exoskeleton balance evaluation human-in-the-loop perturbation-based gait composite cost function

简要说明：该论文提出了一种参与者特定的复合平衡代价，结合学习融合权重和经验贝叶斯层次模型，用于在人体在环步态扰动实验中选择有前景的髋关节外骨骼辅助条件，并在三名参与者中证明了更小的高概率候选集和改善的结果。

TLDR: This paper proposes a participant-specific composite balance cost with learned fusion weights and an empirical-Bayes hierarchical model to select promising hip exoskeleton assistance conditions for human-in-the-loop gait perturbation experiments, demonstrating smaller high-probability candidate sets and improved outcomes across three participants.

Abstract: Hip exoskeletons may improve recovery from unexpected gait perturbations, yet personalizing assistance remains difficult because balance is multidimensional and human-in-the-loop experiments are small-sample and noisy. We present a participant-specific composite balance cost that integrates seven biomechanical sub-metrics spanning margin of stability, center-of-mass dynamics, and whole-body angular momentum. The sub-metrics are converted to direction-aligned, dimensionless cost features, and nonnegative fusion weights are learned on the simplex. Coupled with an empirical-Bayes hierarchical model, the learned-composite selector estimates each tested condition's posterior probability of being best, P(best), and a high-probability candidate set with size $K_{0.8}$. The framework was evaluated with three participants walking at 1.1 m/s during unilateral belt-slip perturbations across 46 hip-assistance conditions. In the full-budget analysis (B = 4 repeats per condition), the selector concentrated 80% of the posterior probability within 1 to 5 of 46 conditions, compared with 2 to 12 for equal-weight fusion and 4 to 37 for principal component analysis fusion. This smaller candidate set could shorten personalization experiments and limit participants' exposure to repeated perturbations in future studies. Selected-condition trials showed lower observed composite costs than no-torque trials, with nominal p < 0.05 for P2 and P3. Leave-one-repeat-out refits yielded positive mean held-out rank correlations for all participants and moderate stability of the learned weights and candidate sets. These proof-of-concept results support participant-specific composite balance evaluation for candidate selection in perturbation-based human-in-the-loop experiments.

摘要（中文）：髋部外骨骼可能改善对意外步态扰动的恢复，但个性化辅助仍面临挑战，因为平衡具有多维性，且人在回路实验样本量小、噪声大。我们提出了一种参与者特异的复合平衡代价函数，整合了七个生物力学子指标，涵盖稳定裕度、质心动力学和全身角动量。子指标被转换为方向对齐的无量纲代价特征，非负融合权重在单纯形上进行学习。结合经验贝叶斯层次模型，所学复合选择器估计每个测试条件为最优的后验概率P(best)，以及大小为$K_{0.8}$的高概率候选集。该框架在3名参与者以1.1 m/s行走、单侧传送带滑动扰动条件下，对46种髋部辅助模式进行了评估。在全预算分析中（每种条件B=4次重复），选择器将80%的后验概率集中在46种条件中的1至5种，而等权融合和主成分分析融合分别为2至12种和4至37种。该更小的候选集可缩短个性化实验时间，并在未来研究中限制参与者暴露于重复扰动的次数。选定条件下的试验显示，其观测复合代价低于无力矩条件，P2和P3的名义p值<0.05。留一重复交叉重拟合在所有参与者中均产生正的均值留出秩相关，且学习权重和候选集具有中等稳定性。这些概念验证结果支持在基于扰动的人机回路实验中采用参与者特异的复合平衡评估进行候选选择。

Beyond Dead Reckoning: A Point of View on Camera--DAS--GNSS Continuity in Road Tunnels AutonomousDriving

tunnel localization cross-modal fusion distributed acoustic sensing integrity monitoring connected and automated vehicles

简要说明：本文提出，隧道内定位应被视为基础设施辅助的跨模态轨道连续性，通过边缘计算融合相机、分布式声学传感和全球导航卫星系统，而非从最后可信卫星修正进行外推，并提出了可证伪的研究与部署议程。

TLDR: This Point of View paper argues that tunnel localization for connected and automated vehicles should be treated as infrastructure-assisted cross-modal track continuity, using cameras, DAS, and GNSS fused via edge computing, rather than as extrapolation from the last trusted satellite fix. It proposes a falsifiable research and deployment agenda for integrity-aware tunnel positioning continuity.

Abstract: Road tunnels remove satellite visibility where connected and automated vehicles still require continuous, attributable, and integrity-bounded positioning. This Point of View argues that tunnel localization should be treated as infrastructure-assisted cross-modal track continuity, not as extrapolation from the last trusted satellite fix. A trusted portal satellite solution provides the global anchor, distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) continuous motion evidence, cameras sparse identity and lane anchors, onboard sensing short-term dynamics, and edge computing association, fusion, integrity monitoring, and guarded reacquisition. Ground truth is reserved for offline calibration and validation. The article develops a falsifiable research and deployment agenda for progressing from synchronized multimodal evidence to validated, integrity-aware tunnel positioning continuity.

摘要（中文）：公路隧道会遮蔽卫星信号，而联网与自动驾驶车辆仍需要连续、可归属且具有完整性边界的定位能力。本文观点认为，隧道定位应被视为基础设施辅助的跨模态轨迹连续性问题，而非对最后可信卫星定位的外推。可信的洞口卫星解算提供全局锚点，分布式声学传感（DAS）提供连续运动证据，摄像头提供稀疏的身份与车道锚点，车载感知提供短期动力学信息，边缘计算负责关联、融合、完整性监测及有防护的重新捕获。地面真值仅用于离线标定与验证。本文提出了一项可证伪的研究与部署议程，旨在从同步多模态证据推进到经过验证的、具备完整性感知的隧道定位连续性。

Authors: Lyes Saad Saoud, Hesham A. Rakha, Mona Jaber, Moussa Ayyash

One Model, Two Physical Stories: Auditing Misalignment in Multi-Modal World Modeling WorldModel

multi-modal world models internal misalignment external misalignment physics-grounded evaluation cross-modal consistency

简要说明：本文审计多模态世界模型中的跨模态不一致性和物理不保真问题，提出合同和基于物理的流程来量化内部和外部错位。研究发现，统一骨干网络往往无法同时实现正确的推理、内部一致性和外部物理保真度。

TLDR: This paper audits multi-modal world models for cross-modal inconsistency and physical infidelity, proposing contracts and a physics-grounded pipeline to measure internal and external misalignment. It finds that unified backbones often fail to simultaneously achieve correct reasoning, internal consistency, and external physical fidelity.

Abstract: World models, systems that generate what happens next given current environmental conditions, are increasingly being implemented with multi-modal generation in mind. However, generating multiple modalities simultaneously, such as visual simulations alongside physical state predictions in the form of text, introduces the risk of cross-modal inconsistency. Tested separately, both outputs may look convincing while still disagreeing: a model can calculate that a ball should rebound in one modality, then generate no rebound in another modality, to say nothing of diverging from real-world dynamics entirely. In this work we focus on two failures explicitly: \emph{Internal misalignment}, the disagreement between the world model's generated video and the same world model's prediction in a different modalities, and \emph{external misalignment} the disagreement between the world model's generation and an analytic physical environment. We derive common contracts of event, magnitude, timing, and construct a physics grounded pipeline to make comparisons measurable in both external and internal settings. We then ask whether progressively supplying the model's own contract (the A ladder for the internal setting) or a corrected physical contract (the B ladder for the external setting) closes the respective gaps. Across four mechanisms and 20 settings, we find that while language answers all 22 text probes correctly with respect to the true environment, the neutral video is often in disagreement, suggesting that the current unified backbones may not be capable of correct reasoning, internal consistency, and external physical fidelity all at once.

摘要（中文）：世界模型，即在给定当前环境条件下生成后续可能发生情况的系统，正越来越多地以多模态生成为目标进行实现。然而，同时生成多种模态——例如视觉模拟与以文本形式呈现的物理状态预测——会引入跨模态不一致的风险。若分别测试，两种输出可能各自看起来都具有说服力，但彼此之间仍存在矛盾：模型可以在一种模态中计算出球应当反弹，却在另一种模态中生成不反弹的结果，更不用说完全偏离真实世界动力学的情况了。在本研究中，我们明确聚焦于两类失败：\emph{内部错位}，即世界模型生成的视频与该同一世界模型在其他模态中的预测之间的不一致；以及\emph{外部错位}，即世界模型的生成结果与分析性物理环境之间的不一致。我们推导出事件、量级和时序的通用契约，并构建了一条基于物理学的流水线，使外部和内部场景中的比较均可量化测量。随后，我们探究逐步向模型提供其自身契约（内部场景中的A阶梯）或经过校正的物理契约（外部场景中的B阶梯）是否能够弥合相应的差距。在四种机制和20种设置下，我们发现，虽然语言模态在所有22项文本测验中均正确对应了真实环境，但中性视频往往存在不一致，这表明当前统一的骨干网络可能无法同时具备正确的推理能力、内部一致性以及外部的物理保真度。

Authors: Geigh Zollicoffer, Minh Vu, Rajiv Ranasinghe, Manish Bhattarai

Goal-Oriented Communications for Physical AI: Design and Testbed Other

goal-oriented communication semantic representation physical AI 5G testbed robotic control

简要说明：本文为物理AI设计并评估了三种面向目标的通信框架，通过5G测试床传输语义表示（3D边界框、2D/3D场景图），并连接到机器人臂和边缘服务器，在任务完成时间和成功率上取得显著提升。

TLDR: This paper designs and evaluates three goal-oriented communication frameworks for Physical AI, transmitting semantic representations (3D bounding boxes, 2D/3D scene graphs) over a real 5G testbed connected to a robot arm and edge server, reducing task completion time and improving success probability.

Abstract: Physical AI relies on frequently-updated, latency-sensitive video stream to perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world, resulting in strict latency requirements with much higher data volumes that existing 5G networks cannot support. Goal-oriented communication (GoC) offers as a promising approach to solve this challenge by transmitting only task-relevant semantic representations. However, existing GoC frameworks were mainly evaluated in the simulations while their effectiveness has never been validated in a practical deployment of physical AI application. In this work, we develop an end-to-end GoC testbed for Physical AI, which connects a PiPER robot arm equipped with an RGB-D camera and a 5G modem to an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin edge server through a 5G OpenAirInterface network. We propose and implement three GoC frameworks that transmit 3D bounding boxes, 2D scene graphs, and 3D scene graphs, as three types of semantic representations, respectively. They share the common functional modules designed for closed-loop Physical AI applications, including semantic extraction, full stack 5G transmission, language model inference, digital twin validation, and robotic control. Extensive experiments on our testbed show that our GoC frameworks reduce the task completion time by up to 52.6% and improve task success probability by up to 45%, compared to the traditional framework that periodically transmits the raw image data. These results validate the practical effectiveness of our GoC framework and pave the way for efficient and reliable Physical AI applications over future 6G networks. Project website: https://sites.google.com/view/goc-physical-ai-testbed.

摘要（中文）：物理人工智能依赖于频繁更新、对延迟敏感的视频流来感知、推理并与物理世界交互，这带来了现有5G网络无法支持的严格时延要求以及更高数据量。目标导向通信（GoC）通过仅传输与任务相关的语义表示，为应对这一挑战提供了一种有前景的方案。然而，现有的GoC框架主要是在仿真环境中进行评估，其有效性从未在实际部署的物理AI应用中得到验证。在本工作中，我们为物理AI开发了一个端到端的GoC测试平台，该平台将配备RGB-D摄像头和5G调制解调器的PiPER机械臂，通过5G OpenAirInterface网络连接到NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin边缘服务器。我们提出并实现了三种GoC框架，分别传输3D边界框、2D场景图和3D场景图作为三种类型的语义表示。它们共享为闭环物理AI应用设计的通用功能模块，包括语义提取、全协议栈5G传输、语言模型推理、数字孪生验证和机器人控制。在我们测试平台上进行的大量实验表明，与定期传输原始图像数据的传统框架相比，我们的GoC框架将任务完成时间最多缩短了52.6%，将任务成功概率最多提高了45%。这些结果验证了我们GoC框架的实际有效性，并为未来6G网络上高效可靠的物理AI应用铺平了道路。项目网站：https://sites.google.com/view/goc-physical-ai-testbed。

Authors: Shutong Chen, Wenkai Zhang, Adnan Aijaz, Miao Guo, Yansha Deng

An Information-Space Perspective to Scene Graph Sufficiency for Robotic Task Planning Other

scene graph task planning information spaces transition systems quotient abstraction

简要说明：本文利用信息空间框架形式化了机器人任务规划中场景图充分性的概念，通过定义转移系统和商模型来刻画精简场景图何时能保持规划可行性。

TLDR: This paper formalizes scene graph sufficiency for robotic task planning using an information-spaces framework, defining transition systems and quotient models to characterize when reduced scene graphs preserve plan feasibility.

Abstract: Planning in complex environments requires task specifications grounded in representations that capture objects, relations, and affordances; scene graphs meet this need, but their size in large environments hinders efficient planning. While task-aware pruning and hierarchical abstractions have been explored, a general, task-centric formalization of what constitutes a sufficient scene graph for planning remains open. This paper provides such a formalization by modeling planning over scene graphs within an information-spaces framework through the definition of scene graph transition systems and relevant action semantics for navigation and manipulation. We then introduce derived scene graphs via information mappings that merge and prune nodes and induce quotient transition systems augmented with motion primitives to capture higher-level actions over merged graph nodes. Sufficiency is characterized by two conditions: (i) the information mapping yields a deterministic quotient, and (ii) the task is well-posed over derived traces, ensuring plans found on the derived model are feasible on the maximal system. We illustrate the framework using a task over an example environment, showing both sufficient and insufficient reduced scene graphs.

摘要（中文）：在复杂环境中进行规划，需要将任务规格建立在能够捕捉对象、关系与功能属性的表征之上；场景图能够满足这一需求，但在大规模环境中，其规模会阻碍高效规划。尽管已有研究探讨了任务感知剪枝与层次化抽象方法，但对于何种场景图足以支持规划这一问题的通用且以任务为中心的正式化定义，仍然有待解决。本文通过在信息空间框架内对基于场景图的规划进行建模，提出了场景图转移系统及面向导航与操作的相关动作语义，从而提供了这样一套正式化定义。随后，我们通过信息映射引入派生场景图，该映射对节点进行合并与剪枝，并诱导出商转移系统，同时辅以运动原语，以捕捉合并图节点上的高层动作。充分性由两个条件刻画：（i）信息映射产生确定性商系统；（ii）任务在派生轨迹上具有适定性，确保在派生模型上找到的规划在最大系统上是可行的。我们通过一个示例环境中的任务来说明该框架，展示了充分与不充分的精简场景图两种情况。

Authors: Başak Sakçak, Francesco Verdoja

P-POSEMEM: Projective Semantic Memory for Consistent Language Grounding under Pose-Graph Rewrites Other

semantic memory language grounding pose-graph SLAM robotic perception consistency

简要说明：本文提出P-POSEMEM，一种机器人语义记忆机制，通过将观测存储为不可变事件并在重建的联合后验上积分语义似然，确保在SLAM位姿图优化和边缘化过程中语言接地的一致性。

TLDR: This paper presents P-POSEMEM, a semantic memory mechanism for robots that maintains consistent language grounding despite SLAM pose-graph optimizations and marginalization, by storing observations as immutable events and integrating semantic likelihoods over the reconstructed joint posterior.

Abstract: A robot following language instructions needs its semantic memory to keep naming the same physical object while the SLAM pose graph underneath is optimized, loop-closed and compressed. Maps committing each detection to a world coordinate cannot: a closure moves the anchor it was measured from, or the solver marginalizes that anchor, and the query then selects a different object although both graphs represent the same posterior. P-POSEMEM stores each observation as an immutable event at its birth keyframe, retains the Bayes-tree elimination conditional of every marginalized keyframe, and integrates the semantic likelihood over the reconstructed joint posterior of poses, anchors and identities. Dproj, the total-variation defect between the language-goal distributions of inference-equivalent full and marginalized graphs, measures this directly. Over 40 HM3DSem scenes and 112,000 queries, P-POSEMEM reproduces the full-graph oracle (Dproj = 0) and reduces goal flips against every memory-reducing baseline. On an eight-run campaign whose 761 closures rewrote the map by up to 47 m, Dproj stays below 10^-13 with 0/288 goal flips when elimination follows the closures, where every ablation and a coordinate committed at insertion flip goals it does not; under a live bounded solver the same memory flips 23/288 against 53 for that frozen coordinate. A pre-registered negative control is detected by Dproj while leaving calibration error and navigation success unchanged, indicating that these measures capture distinct failure modes. Retrieval is held fixed by a shared frozen detector, isolating the gain to memory consistency. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/posemem-2328/.

摘要（中文）：跟随语言指令的机器人需要其语义记忆在底层SLAM位姿图被优化、闭环及压缩的过程中，持续为同一物理对象命名。将每次检测提交至世界坐标的地图无法做到这一点：闭环会移动该检测所依据的锚点，或求解器会边缘化该锚点，导致查询所选对象发生变化，尽管两种图表示的是相同的后验。P-POSEMEM将每次观测作为不可变事件存储在其诞生关键帧处，保留每个被边缘化关键帧的贝叶斯树消元条件，并在重建的位姿、锚点及身份联合后验上积分语义似然。Dproj——即推理等价的全图与边缘化图之间语言目标分布的全变差缺陷——可直接度量该差异。在40个HM3DSem场景及112,000次查询中，P-POSEMEM复现了全图先知结果（Dproj = 0），并相较所有降低记忆的基线减少了目标翻转。在一项八次运行的实验中，761次闭环将地图改写幅度最高达47米，当消元跟随闭环保序进行时，Dproj保持在10^-13以下，且0/288次目标翻转；而所有消融及插入时提交的坐标都会发生目标翻转。在实时有界求解器下，同样的记忆发生23/288次翻转，而冻结坐标则发生53次。预先注册的阴性对照可被Dproj检测到，同时校准误差与导航成功率保持不变，表明这些度量捕捉的是不同的失效模式。检索过程由共享的冻结检测器固定，从而将性能增益孤立为记忆一致性。代码与数据：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/posemem-2328/。

Authors: Ha Sier, Ali Salmasi, Mengya Xu, Haizhou Zhang, Jie Lu, Zhuo Zou, Xianjia Yu, Tomi Westerlund

InterSocialBench: Benchmarking Human and LLM Preferences for Companion-Robot Social Behavior Other

social behavior benchmark companion robots LLM preferences human-robot interaction behavior selection

简要说明：InterSocialBench 是一个包含210个家庭场景和18种行为的基准，将100名人类参与者的判断与16种人格条件下的23,520条LLM响应配对，用于评估伴侣机器人的社交行为选择，并揭示人类与模型偏好之间的显著多样性差距。

TLDR: InterSocialBench is a benchmark of 210 domestic scenarios and 18 behaviors, pairing human judgments with 23,520 LLM responses under 16 personality conditions, to evaluate social behavior selection for companion robots and reveal significant diversity gaps between human and model preferences.

Abstract: Companion robots face everyday situations in which several feasible behaviors may be appropriate, yet different people prefer different responses. We introduce InterSocialBench, a benchmark of 210 domestic scenarios and 18 high-level behaviors, pairing judgments from 100 human participants with 23,520 responses from seven large language models under 16 personality conditions. Each human annotation preserves a preferred action alongside explicitly appropriate and inappropriate candidates. A structured construction pipeline covers behavioral alternatives, competing situational cues, and relevant history and future tasks. Evaluation distinguishes preferred-choice agreement from explicit rejection, using scenario-grouped splits for trainable predictors. Simple frequency and persona-voting baselines illustrate these objectives. Across the tested prompts, model and human behavior distributions differ, and the diversity gap remains after matching response counts: humans exhibit 4.68 distinct choices per scenario, compared with 2.06--3.46 for the models. Human scenario-level plurality agreement is 51.5%, describing disagreement rather than a universal prediction ceiling. InterSocialBench supports evaluating social behavior selection without replacing individual judgments with a single consensus label.

摘要（中文）：陪伴机器人所面对的日常情境中，往往存在多种合理的行为选项，而不同人群的偏好也各不相同。为此，我们提出了InterSocialBench基准测试集，涵盖210个居家场景及18类高层行为，并汇集了100名人类参与者的判断，以及7种大语言模型在16种人格条件下的23,520条响应。每一条人工标注均保留了一个偏好行为，同时标注了明确合适与明确不合适的行为候选。我们构建了一套结构化的生成流程，用于覆盖备选行为、竞争性情境线索以及相关的历史与未来任务。评估指标区分了偏好选择一致性与明确拒绝行为，并采用按场景划分的数据集进行可训练预测器的评估。简单频率与人格投票基线方法用于说明上述评估目标。在所有测试提示条件下，模型与人类的行为分布存在差异，且在匹配响应数量后，多样性差距依然存在：人类在每个场景中平均做出4.68个不同选择，而模型则为2.06至3.46个。人类在场景层面的多数一致性为51.5%，这反映的是分歧现象，而非普遍预测上限。InterSocialBench旨在支持对社交行为选择进行评估，同时不以单一共识标签取代个体判断。

Authors: Yaodan Xu, Boyang Guo, Yuqing Gu, Qingxin Zhang, Yiwen Deng, Meng Liu, Lintian Li

Low Clearance Hinge Joint Mechanism Based on 3D Printing on Sheet Fabrication Methodology Manipulation

hinge joint 3D printing delta robot low clearance fabrication

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于板材3D打印的低间隙铰链机构，无需粘合剂，并在10厘米级三角洲机器人上实现了精确运动。

TLDR: This paper presents a low-clearance hinge joint mechanism fabricated via 3D printing on sheets, eliminating adhesives and enabling precise motion in a 3-DOF delta robot at the tens-of-centimeters scale.

Abstract: This paper presents a low-clearance hinge joint mechanism based on the 3D printing on sheet fabrication method. This approach simplifies the fabrication of hinge mechanisms and overcomes limitations of conventional origami manufacturing by eliminating the need for adhesives commonly used during assembly, making it suitable for robots at the tens-of-centimeters scale. The advantages and disadvantages of three types of hinge joint mechanisms are compared, and a hinge joint that can be designed with low clearance for various facet thicknesses is selected. Based on the selected hinge joint, the twisting angle and bending force are analyzed, leading to the implementation of a clearance of 0.1 mm. Torsional resistance is experimentally evaluated to measure the torque required for twisting caused by plastic deformation and clearance. The results show that the torque associated with plastic deformation is sufficient to constrain the undesired degrees of freedom of the hinge joint, while the torque required for twisting due to clearance is minimal. Based on the analyzed data, the proposed hinge joint mechanism is applied to a 3-degree-of-freedom delta robot manipulator, demonstrating precise motion with low clearance.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种基于片材三维打印制造方法的低间隙铰链关节机制。该方法简化了铰链机构的制造过程，并通过消除装配过程中通常使用的粘合剂，克服了传统折纸制造的局限性，适用于数十厘米尺度级别的机器人。对三种类型的铰链关节机制进行了优缺点比较，并选择了一种可根据不同面片厚度设计低间隙的铰链关节。基于所选的铰链关节，对扭转角度和弯曲力进行了分析，进而实现了0.1毫米的间隙。通过实验评估了扭转阻力，以测量由塑性变形和间隙引起的扭转所需力矩。结果表明，与塑性变形相关的力矩足以约束铰链关节的非期望自由度，而因间隙引起的扭转所需力矩则非常小。基于分析数据，将所提出的铰链关节机制应用于一个三自由度并联三角机器人操纵器，展示了低间隙下的精确运动。

Authors: Jaehyung Jang, Euibin Shin, Allison M. Okamura, Jee-Hwan Ryu

Distributed Safe Cooperative Vector Field for Trajectory Curvature Constrained Multi-Robot Systems Other

cooperative vector field trajectory curvature constraints multi-robot systems collision avoidance path following

简要说明：本文提出一种面向轨迹曲率约束的多机器人分布式安全协同向量场方法，并仿真和真机验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a distributed safe cooperative vector field method for multi-robot path following under trajectory curvature constraints, validated by simulations and real-robot experiments.

Abstract: Trajectory curvature constraints are inherent in practical multi-robot systems due to the limited turning capabilities of the robots. Without properly accounting for these constraints, robots may fail to accomplish assigned tasks, and their trajectories may diverge from the intended paths. This paper proposes a distributed safe cooperative vector field approach for multi-robot systems subject to trajectory curvature constraints. The proposed approach is composed of a cooperative vector field and a safety-oriented collision avoidance vector field, aiming to address the problems of cooperative motion and safe collision avoidance in multi-robot path-following tasks. A safety-oriented collision avoidance vector field with adaptively adjustable reactive boundary is developed to accommodate the kinematic curvature constraints of robots, thereby ensuring the physical feasibility of collision avoidance maneuvers. The proposed vector field requires only a single virtual variable from each neighboring robot to achieve cooperative motion and ensure both obstacle avoidance and inter-robot collision avoidance. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is validated through both simulations and real-world experiments on an actual multi-robot platform.

摘要（中文）：轨迹曲率约束是实际多机器人系统中固有的问题，源于机器人有限的转向能力。若未能充分考虑这些约束，机器人可能无法完成分配的任务，其轨迹也可能偏离预期路径。本文针对受轨迹曲率约束的多机器人系统，提出了一种分布式安全协同向量场方法。该方法由协同向量场和面向安全的避碰向量场组成，旨在解决多机器人路径跟踪任务中的协同运动与安全避碰问题。通过构建具有自适应可调反应边界的面向安全避碰向量场，以适应机器人的运动学曲率约束，从而确保避碰机动在物理上的可行性。所提出的向量场仅需每个相邻机器人提供一个虚拟变量，即可实现协同运动，并同时保证障碍物规避与机器人间的碰撞避免。通过实际多机器人平台上的仿真与实物实验，验证了所提方法的有效性。

Authors: Zhouru Xiao, Tao Teng, Weijia Yao, Hui Zhang, Xiangke Wang, Yaonan Wang

HydroMap: Probabilistic Water Surface Elevation Mapping for Semantic Scene Representation in Inland Waterways Perception3D

probabilistic elevation mapping semantic scene representation autonomous surface vehicles stereo observations LiDAR mapping

简要说明：HydroMap 通过立体观测重建概率性水面高程图，并将其与 LiDAR 结构图集成，用于内河航道中的自主水面车辆，实现了低于 5 厘米的高程均方根误差。

TLDR: HydroMap reconstructs a probabilistic water surface elevation map from stereo observations and integrates it with LiDAR-based structural maps for autonomous surface vehicles in inland waterways, achieving sub-5 cm elevation RMSE.

Abstract: Autonomous surface vehicles operating in inland waterways require a persistent representation of both surrounding structures and the water surface. LiDAR-based simultaneous localization and mapping often produces sparse or missing water returns, leaving this operational surface absent from the reconstructed scene. We propose HydroMap, an odometry-decoupled framework that reconstructs water surface elevation from stereo observations and integrates it with the structural map. Per-frame water points form joint cell observations with propagated stereo and pose uncertainty, and successive observations are fused into a persistent probabilistic elevation map. Semantic map conversion then combines the elevation map with structural geometry in a unified 2.5D representation of water, boundaries, structures, and overhead regions. On the Pohang Canal and Leuven Vaart datasets, the elevation RMSE remains below 5 cm relative to LiDAR references expressed in the same map frame. The elevation and semantic maps are published at 2 Hz and 1 Hz, respectively. HydroMap thereby complements LiDAR maps with a persistent representation of the water surface for downstream navigation in inland waterways.

摘要（中文）：自主式水面航行器在内陆水道中运行时，需要对周围结构物及水面进行持续表征。基于激光雷达的同时定位与建图技术常常产生稀疏或缺失的水面回波，导致重建场景中缺少这一作业表面。我们提出HydroMap，一种与里程计解耦的框架，该框架从立体观测中重建水面高程，并将其与结构地图集成。逐帧水面点与传播的立体及位姿不确定性形成联合单元观测，连续的观测被融合为持续的概率高程地图。随后，语义地图转换将高程地图与结构几何统一为包含水面、边界、结构物及上方区域的一体化2.5D表示。在浦项运河和鲁汶运河数据集上，相对于同一地图坐标系下表示的激光雷达参考值，高程均方根误差保持在5厘米以内。高程地图和语义地图分别以2赫兹和1赫兹的频率发布。由此，HydroMap通过持续的水面表征补充激光雷达地图，为内陆水道中的下游导航提供支持。

Authors: Zhongbi Luo, Yunjia Wang, Herman Bruyninckx, Peter Slaets

An Adaptive Fixed-Time Line-of-Sight Guidance Scheme for 3D Path Following of Underwater Vehicles: Theory and Experiment Other

fixed-time stability line-of-sight guidance autonomous underwater vehicle path following adaptive estimator

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于自主水下航行器（AUV）三维路径跟踪的固定时间自适应视线（LOS）制导框架，结合固定时间自适应估计器和时变前瞻机制，在预设时间内确保收敛且不依赖初始条件，并通过仿真和Iver 3 AUV的物理实验验证了其优于现有自适应LOS方法的跟踪精度和抗干扰能力。

TLDR: This paper proposes a fixed-time adaptive line-of-sight (LOS) guidance framework for 3D path following of autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs), incorporating a fixed-time adaptive estimator for sideslip compensation and a time-varying look-ahead mechanism. The method guarantees convergence within a preset time independent of initial conditions and is validated through both simulations and physical experiments on an Iver 3 AUV, showing significant improvements in tracking accuracy and disturbance rejection.

Abstract: Reliable path tracking is crucial for autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) operating in dynamic and uncertain marine environments. However, traditional line-of-sight (LOS) guidance methods rely on asymptotic convergence, resulting in slow disturbance recovery and unpredictable tracking performance. Existing robust control methods typically require modifications to the underlying vehicle controller, limiting their practical application on commercial AUV platforms. This paper proposes a robust fixed-time adaptive LOS guidance framework for 3D path tracking for AUVs. By combining fixed-time stability theory with LOS guidance, this method guarantees path tracking convergence within a preset time range, with the convergence time independent of initial conditions. Furthermore, a fixed-time adaptive estimator is developed to rapidly compensate for time-varying sideslip disturbances caused by ocean currents. A time-varying look-ahead mechanism is also introduced to improve tracking performance on curved paths. Lyapunov analysis proves the fixed-time stability of the proposed framework, and numerical simulations and physical experiments demonstrate that, compared to state-of-the-art adaptive LOS methods, this framework exhibits superior tracking accuracy, convergence speed, and anti-interference capability. In simulation, the time-varying look-ahead variant reduced cross-track and vertical-track RMSE by 69.37\% and 67.46\%, respectively, during curved-path tracking. In field experiments with an Iver 3 AUV, the proposed fixed-time guidance reduced average tracking error by 56.35\% in straight-path evaluation and 27.59\% in curved-path evaluation compared with conventional adaptive LOS guidance.The proposed method provides a practical guidance-level solution for achieving reliable autonomous navigation of AUVs in complex marine environments.

摘要（中文）：可靠路径跟踪对于在动态和不确定海洋环境中运行的自主水下航行器（AUV）至关重要。然而，传统的视线（LOS）制导方法依赖于渐近收敛，导致扰动恢复缓慢且跟踪性能不可预测。现有鲁棒控制方法通常需要对底层航行器控制器进行修改，限制了其在商用AUV平台上的实际应用。本文提出了一种用于AUV三维路径跟踪的鲁棒固定时间自适应LOS制导框架。通过将固定时间稳定性理论与LOS制导相结合，该方法保证路径跟踪在预设时间范围内收敛，且收敛时间与初始条件无关。此外，开发了一种固定时间自适应估计器，用于快速补偿由海流引起的时变侧滑扰动。还引入了一种时变前视距离机制，以提高弯曲路径上的跟踪性能。Lyapunov分析证明了所提出框架的固定时间稳定性，数值仿真和物理实验表明，与最先进的自适应LOS方法相比，该框架具有更优越的跟踪精度、收敛速度和抗干扰能力。在仿真中，时变前视距离变体在弯曲路径跟踪中分别将横向跟踪误差和垂直跟踪误差的均方根误差（RMSE）降低了69.37%和67.46%。在使用Iver 3 AUV的外场实验中，与传统自适应LOS制导相比，所提出的固定时间制导在直线路径评估中平均跟踪误差降低了56.35%，在弯曲路径评估中降低了27.59%。该方法为AUV在复杂海洋环境中实现可靠自主导航提供了一种实用的制导层面解决方案。

Authors: Hanzhi Yang, Jalil Chavez-Galaviz, Nina Mahmoudian

A Novel Robot-Assisted Learning Pedagogy for Children with ASD HumanoidEmbodied

robot-assisted intervention autism learning-by-teaching social skills engagement

简要说明：本文介绍了一种针对自闭症儿童的机器人辅助学习教学法，表明使用机器人比人类同伴更能提高社交技能任务的参与度和表现。

TLDR: This paper introduces a robot-assisted learning-by-teaching pedagogy for children with ASD, showing that using a robot improves engagement and performance on social skills tasks compared to a human confederate.

Abstract: Interaction paradigms used in robot-assisted autism intervention have historically employed robots as teachers, clinical assistants, or more-abled peers to promote a variety of social skills. These modalities often leverage the expertise of trained practitioners to ensure that child-robot interactions are productive or clinically grounded to yield positive therapeutic benefits for children across the autism spectrum. Yet, despite the fact that the majority of children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) attend mainstream schools and spend 80% or more of their time in the general classroom [27], there is a paucity of research incorporating validated classroom teaching pedagogies into robot-assisted autism interventions. In this work, we introduce a novel teaching methodology for advancing social skills in school-aged children with ASD. We evaluate the effectiveness of a novel robot-assisted autism intervention which incorporates the learning-by-teaching pedagogy and explores the comparative benefits of employing a robot versus a human confederate for improved performance on a set of social skills tasks. Results show that 80% of study participants performed better in the robot condition (mean performance in the robot condition=63%, mean performance in the confederate condition=37%), irrespective of the scenario order. Further, 90% of all participants were significantly more engaged in the robot condition (mean engagement: robot=61%, confederate=32%) and, while the effect did not result in the confederate condition, analyses indicate that overall engagement in the robot condition contributed to improved performance. These results suggest that robots employed in a learning-by-teaching context may help enhance engagement and improve performance on a simple social skills task for children with ASD.

摘要（中文）：机器人辅助自闭症干预中使用的交互范式历来将机器人作为教师、临床助手或能力更强的同伴，以促进多种社交技能的发展。这些模式通常借助受过训练的专业人员的专业知识，确保儿童与机器人之间的互动富有成效或在临床上有据可依，从而为自闭症谱系中的儿童带来积极的治疗效果。然而，尽管大多数自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）儿童就读于主流学校，并且有80%或更多的时间待在普通教室中[27]，但将经过验证的课堂教学法融入机器人辅助自闭症干预的研究仍然很少。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新的教学方法，旨在促进学龄期ASD儿童社交技能的发展。我们评估了一种新颖的机器人辅助自闭症干预的有效性，该干预融合了“向他人教学而学习”的教学法，并探讨了使用机器人相较于人类助手在提升一组社交技能任务表现方面的相对优势。结果显示，80%的研究参与者在机器人条件下表现更好（机器人条件下的平均表现=63%，人类助手条件下的平均表现=37%），无论场景顺序如何。此外，90%的所有参与者在机器人条件下显著更加投入（平均投入度：机器人=61%，人类助手=32%），并且，尽管这种效果并未在人类助手条件下出现，但分析表明，机器人条件下的整体投入度有助于提升表现。这些结果表明，在“向他人教学而学习”的背景下使用机器人，可能有助于增强ASD儿童的参与度，并提高其在一项简单社交技能任务中的表现。

Authors: Laura Boccanfuso, Erin Barney, Marilena Mademtzi, Claire Foster, Quan Wang, Colette Torres, Lisa Chen, Brian Scassellati, Pamela Ventola, Frederick Shic

Unsupervised Point Cloud Registration via Training-Time Semantic Guidance Perception3D

unsupervised point cloud registration LiDAR semantic guidance teacher-student framework pseudo-label mining

简要说明：CAESAR 是一个用于无监督 LiDAR 点云配准的教师-学生框架，在训练期间利用现成的 3D 分割模型指导伪标签挖掘和特征蒸馏，在 KITTI 和 nuScenes 上提升了性能，且无推理开销。

TLDR: CAESAR is a teacher-student framework for unsupervised LiDAR point cloud registration that uses an off-the-shelf 3D segmentation model during training to guide pseudo-label mining and feature distillation, improving performance on KITTI and nuScenes with no inference overhead.

Abstract: Unsupervised registration of large-scale LiDAR point clouds remains challenging due to the geometric ambiguity inherent in outdoor scenes, which degrades pseudo-label quality and leads to suboptimal convergence, particularly for sparse, low-resolution scans such as those from nuScenes. We reveal that registration models intrinsically encode semantic awareness that strongly correlates with registration accuracy, albeit without explicit semantic supervision. However, this native awareness is fragile: noisy supervision arising from geometric ambiguity in unsupervised settings rapidly erodes the learned semantic structure, causing performance collapse. To this end, we propose CAESAR, a teacher-student framework guided by an off-the-shelf 3D segmentation model exclusively during training. We observe that potential inlier matches are often buried just beneath a few spurious neighbors in the noisy feature space, motivating Dual-Cue Guided Re-Matching to recover them through reselection rather than simply rejecting. Building on this, a train-only Semantic-Geometric Label Mining performs lightweight, batch-specific teacher refinement and mines reliable pseudo-labels under semantic guidance. We further introduce Semantic Predictive Distillation to consolidate the student's semantic awareness in the feature space. Extensive experiments on KITTI and nuScenes demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, with pronounced gains on the challenging nuScenes benchmark. Crucially, CAESAR incurs zero inference overhead and requires no semantic annotations on the registration data. Code will be released.

摘要（中文）：大规模LiDAR点云的无监督配准由于户外场景中固有的几何模糊性而仍然具有挑战性，这种模糊性会降低伪标签质量并导致次优收敛，尤其是对于来自nuScenes等数据集的稀疏、低分辨率扫描而言。我们揭示了配准模型内在地编码了与配准精度密切相关的语义感知能力，尽管没有显式的语义监督。然而，这种天然的感知能力是脆弱的：无监督设置中由几何模糊性产生的噪声监督会迅速侵蚀已学习的语义结构，导致性能崩溃。为此，我们提出了CAESAR，一种仅在训练期间由现成的3D分割模型引导的教师-学生框架。我们观察到，潜在的匹配内点往往深埋在噪声特征空间中几个伪邻近点之下，这促使我们提出双线索引导的重新匹配方法，通过重新选择而非简单拒绝来恢复这些内点。在此基础上，一种仅用于训练的语义-几何标签挖掘方法执行轻量级的、批次特定的教师细化，并在语义引导下挖掘可靠的伪标签。我们进一步引入语义预测蒸馏，以巩固学生在特征空间中的语义感知能力。在KITTI和nuScenes上的大量实验证明了该方法达到了最先进的性能，在具有挑战性的nuScenes基准上获得了显著的提升。关键在于，CAESAR在推理时零额外开销，且不需要对配准数据进行语义标注。代码将予以发布。
